Overture to Despair#000.src: Meet up with Sui outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#001.src: ...{p}. Ha, the... the tourists really weren't lying when they kept saying it was a work of art.
Overture to Despair#001.dst: ...{p}. 하, 관광객들이 예술 작품이라고 떠들던 게 진짜 거짓말이 아니었네.
Overture to Despair#001.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#002.src: It must be nice, living here... being able to ignore everything going on everywhere else...
Overture to Despair#002.dst: 여기 사는 건 좋겠다... 다른 데서 무슨 일이 벌어지든 모른 척할 수 있으니까...
Overture to Despair#002.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#003.src: {u}, we need to find that... that so-called "number one" Sovereign! If we can do that, then... ha, then we can save Rex and Zeph.
Overture to Despair#003.dst: {u}, 그... 그 '넘버원' 군주라는 놈을 찾아야 해! 그러면... 하, 그러면 Rex랑 Zeph를 구할 수 있어.
Overture to Despair#003.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#004.src: Why not?! You're the one who wanted to- to rush into Deraj and free everyone without even stopping to think about it!
Overture to Despair#004.dst: 왜 안 돼?! 생각도 안 하고 Deraj에 쳐, 쳐들어가서 다 풀어 주자고 했던 건 너잖아!
Overture to Despair#004.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#005.src: So why can't I?! The longer we wait, the more chances there are for s-something to happen!! We need to go already!
Overture to Despair#005.dst: 그럼 나는 왜 안 되는데?! 오래 기다릴수록 무, 무슨 일이 생길 수도 있어!! 당장 가야 해!
Overture to Despair#005.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#006.src: Yeah, I have one. Find the Sovereign. Free Rex and Zeph. And get out of there!
Overture to Despair#006.dst: 응, 있어. 군주를 찾는다. Rex랑 Zeph를 풀어 준다. 그리고 빠져나온다!
Overture to Despair#006.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#007.src: I'll... f-fill in the details as we go. I will! We just need to go already!
Overture to Despair#007.dst: 세부 사항은... 가, 가면서 채울게. 진짜로! 그냥 당장 가야 한다고!
Overture to Despair#007.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#010.src: I guess... the Canopy? We can bring them to the Canopy! That... that works...
Overture to Despair#010.dst: 아마... Canopy? Canopy로 데려가면 돼! 그거면... 그거면 되겠네...
Overture to Despair#010.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#011.src: Um... n-no, I guess not. But- but we can find someone who does, and- and force the information out of them!
Overture to Despair#011.dst: 음... 아, 아니, 모르지. 하지만- 하지만 아는 사람을 찾아서- 정보를 억지로 캐내면 돼!
Overture to Despair#011.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#012.src: We can do that. Captain Fuhue, she... told me about some of her methods! I just... need to find someone who... knows...
Overture to Despair#012.dst: 할 수 있어. Fuhue 대장이... 자기 방식 몇 가지를 알려 줬거든! 난 그냥... 아는 사람을... 찾기만 하면...
Overture to Despair#012.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#013.src: If- if that's what it takes!! We were able to k-kill Gikyo, weren't we?
Overture to Despair#013.dst: 그- 그래야 한다면!! 우리 Gikyo도 주, 죽였잖아?
Overture to Despair#013.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#014.src: Even if it was hard... and Majin is... probably stronger...
Overture to Despair#014.dst: 힘들긴 했지만... 그리고 Majin은... 아마 더 강하겠지...
Overture to Despair#014.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#015.src: Good. Okay! To start with, we...
Overture to Despair#015.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#018.src: Okay, fine, maybe you're right! Just... ugh!! We have to do something!
Overture to Despair#018.dst: 그래, 알았어, 네 말이 맞을지도! 그냥... 으!! 뭐라도 해야 한다고!
Overture to Despair#018.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#019.src: ...right. That's... smart. Word's probably spread from, um, {p}, hasn't it...? We'll need to blend in better.
Overture to Despair#019.dst: ...맞아. 그거... 똑똑하네. 소문이, 음, {p}에서 퍼졌을 테니까...? 더 잘 섞여들어야 해.
Overture to Despair#019.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#020.src: And... we don't know how long it'll be until we... find the information we need. So... a place to say, too?
Overture to Despair#020.dst: 그리고... 필요한 정보를 찾기까지... 얼마나 걸릴지 몰라. 그러니까... 묵을 곳도?
Overture to Despair#020.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#021.src: Okay. Find new clothes, and find a place to stay. That's a plan. We can do that.
Overture to Despair#021.dst: 좋아. 새 옷을 구하고, 묵을 곳을 찾는다. 계획 됐어. 할 수 있어.
Overture to Despair#021.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#025.src: Indeed, I am. I was raised here in {p}.
Overture to Despair#025.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#026.src: Though, in truth... I've never really left. I'm planning on enlisting in the military once I've completed my provincial tour.
Overture to Despair#026.dst: 하지만 사실... 한 번도 떠나 본 적이 없어요. 지방 순회를 마치면 군에 입대할 생각이에요.
Overture to Despair#026.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#027.src: I've been saving up for years for a round-trip ticket throughout the province... I'd like to see all of the less-fortunate regions firsthand.
Overture to Despair#027.dst: 지방 전역 왕복표를 사려고 몇 년을 모았어요... 형편이 어려운 지역들을 직접 보고 싶거든요.
Overture to Despair#027.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#028.src: I'm leaving just after the festival. Exciting, isn't it?
Overture to Despair#028.dst: 축제 끝나고 바로 떠나요. 신나지 않나요?
Overture to Despair#028.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#029.src: Hotels... hm. I know of several, though most have probably filled entirely for the upcoming festival.
Overture to Despair#029.dst: 호텔이라... 흠. 몇 군데 알지만, 다가오는 축제 때문에 대부분 꽉 찼을 거예요.
Overture to Despair#029.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#030.src: There is a fancy hotel north of the bank... The Crown Jewel, I believe? It's probably far too expensive for you, however.
Overture to Despair#030.dst: 은행 북쪽에 고급 호텔이 있어요... 왕관의 보석이라던가? 다만 당신들한테는 너무 비쌀 거예요.
Overture to Despair#030.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#031.src: A fine question. I'm not too certain, honestly... growing up here has made me overlook things.
Overture to Despair#031.dst: 좋은 질문이네요. 솔직히 잘 모르겠어요... 여기서 자라서 오히려 못 보고 지나치거든요.
Overture to Despair#031.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#032.src: I know tourists typically travel here to look at all our mansions and castles, though. Perhaps you'd be interested?
Overture to Despair#032.dst: 그래도 관광객들은 보통 저택과 성을 보러 온다던데요. 관심 있으신가요?
Overture to Despair#032.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#035.src: How might I help you this fine day?
Overture to Despair#035.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#036.src: As fine as one may be! Thank you for your inquiry.
Overture to Despair#036.dst: 더할 나위 없이 좋지요! 물어봐 주셔서 감사합니다.
Overture to Despair#036.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#037.src: I have been graciously afforded an hour off from my work, so I have chosen to take the time and... smell the roses. To admire the beauty of our city.
Overture to Despair#037.dst: 감사하게도 한 시간 휴식을 받아서... 잠시 여유를 즐기기로 했답니다. 우리 도시의 아름다움을 감상하면서요.
Overture to Despair#037.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#038.src: Ah... tourists from the lower districts, I take it? A fine use of your travel allotments.
Overture to Despair#038.dst: 아... 아래 구역에서 온 관광객이신가 보군요? 여행 할당량을 잘 쓰셨네요.
Overture to Despair#038.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#039.src: You will want to visit the bustling market on the west side, it would be a shame to miss it!
Overture to Despair#039.dst: 서쪽의 북적이는 시장에 꼭 가 보세요. 놓치면 아까울 거예요!
Overture to Despair#039.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#040.src: And if you wish to leave the bounds of the city, I have heard one may find tour guides which will bring you to see the mountains!
Overture to Despair#040.dst: 도시 밖으로 나가고 싶으시다면, 산을 구경시켜 주는 여행 안내인도 있다고 들었어요!
Overture to Despair#040.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#041.src: Yes, {p} is known for its high fashion, isn't it? I'm certain you've heard about it... wherever you come from.
Overture to Despair#041.dst: 네, {p}은(는) 고급 패션으로 유명하죠? 분명 들어 보셨을 거예요... 어디서 오셨든 간에요.
Overture to Despair#041.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#042.src: The famous House Til has placed a pop-up clothes shop to the north, if you're interested.
Overture to Despair#042.dst: 관심 있으시면, 그 유명한 Til 가문이 북쪽에 임시 옷 가게를 열었어요.
Overture to Despair#042.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#043.src: I wish you the best on your stay! Praise be to her Majesty!
Overture to Despair#043.dst: 즐거운 체류 되시길! 여왕 폐하를 찬양하라!
Overture to Despair#043.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#045.src: I should have thought about where I'd be staying... I've never taken a train before, so all my thinking went towards making sure that went well!
Overture to Despair#045.dst: 묵을 곳을 생각했어야 했는데... 기차를 처음 타 봐서 그것만 신경 쓰느라!
Overture to Despair#045.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#046.src: And now all the hotels except the Crown Jewel are fully booked! Will I... will I have to sleep on the street?
Overture to Despair#046.dst: 그런데 왕관의 보석 말고는 호텔이 전부 예약이 찼대요! 설마... 길바닥에서 자야 하나?
Overture to Despair#046.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#047.src: Oh, what am I going to do...?
Overture to Despair#047.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#048.src: Oh, thank you, thank you! The Queen herself must have sent you my way!
Overture to Despair#048.dst: 아, 고마워요, 고마워요! 여왕 폐하께서 직접 당신을 보내 주셨나 봐요!
Overture to Despair#048.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#049.src: ...short on emeralds too, are you? Maybe we can share a comfy bush together! Ha...
Overture to Despair#049.dst: ...당신도 에메랄드가 모자라요? 그럼 푹신한 덤불 하나 같이 쓸까요! 하...
Overture to Despair#049.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#050.src: Oh, I'll remember you forever! You've truly made this festival the best one yet!
Overture to Despair#050.dst: 아, 평생 잊지 않을게요! 덕분에 이번 축제가 최고의 축제가 됐어요!
Overture to Despair#050.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#051.src: I can't wait to tell my old folk all about it! How the Queen had blessed me with this miracle...
Overture to Despair#051.dst: 고향 어르신들한테 빨리 얘기해 드리고 싶어요! 여왕 폐하께서 이런 기적을 내려 주셨다고...
Overture to Despair#051.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#052.src: But, it wasn't the Queen that... oh, nevermind.
Overture to Despair#052.dst: 근데, 그건 여왕이 아니라... 아, 됐다.
Overture to Despair#052.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#053.src: Hello, hello! Care to buy any of our fine papers? Perhaps a magazine is up your alley today- quite the juicy bits of gossip I've heard.
Overture to Despair#053.dst: 안녕하세요, 안녕하세요! 좋은 신문 한 부 어떠세요? 오늘은 잡지가 끌리시려나- 꽤 짭짤한 소문이 있거든요.
Overture to Despair#053.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#054.src: Hm... Do I want the Crown of Seraphim collection, or the Peacock Couture...
Overture to Despair#054.dst: 흠... Crown of Seraphim 컬렉션을 살까, Peacock Couture를 살까...
Overture to Despair#054.speaker: Roughworks Tourist

Overture to Despair#055.src: Oh, this is important... a whole year's paycheck is going towards this!
Overture to Despair#055.dst: 아, 이건 중요해... 1년 치 월급이 여기 들어가는데!
Overture to Despair#055.speaker: Roughworks Tourist

Overture to Despair#058.src: Well, it seems you're in luck! Considering this is a pop-up clothes stall, and all.
Overture to Despair#058.dst: 그럼 운이 좋으시네요! 여긴 임시 옷 가게니까요.
Overture to Despair#058.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#059.src: I'm here representing House Til today. The new fashionable spring line has almost sold out, so shop now if you're interested!
Overture to Despair#059.dst: 오늘 Til 가문을 대표해서 나왔어요. 새 봄 컬렉션이 거의 다 팔렸으니 관심 있으면 지금 고르세요!
Overture to Despair#059.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#060.src: Um... is this the fashion around here?
Overture to Despair#060.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#061.src: Oh, yes. People from all across the province come to shop at these pop-up events.
Overture to Despair#061.dst: 그럼요. 지방 곳곳에서 이런 임시 행사에 쇼핑하러 와요.
Overture to Despair#061.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#062.src: House Til is known for incorporating the designs from peacock feathers into their most extravagant garments!
Overture to Despair#062.dst: Til 가문은 가장 화려한 옷에 공작 깃털 무늬를 넣는 걸로 유명하죠!
Overture to Despair#062.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#063.src: They come in a wide variety of available colours- all from the district's local dye production!
Overture to Despair#063.dst: 색상도 아주 다양해요- 전부 이 구역에서 만든 염료랍니다!
Overture to Despair#063.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#064.src: We don't need anything fancy. Just... show us the cheapest stuff you have, okay?
Overture to Despair#064.dst: 화려한 건 필요 없어. 그냥... 제일 싼 걸로 보여 줘, 알았지?
Overture to Despair#064.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#065.src: My goodness! You must know fashion does not come cheap, miss! Please, allow me to recommend-
Overture to Despair#065.dst: 어머나! 패션은 싸지 않다는 걸 아셔야죠, 아가씨! 제가 추천을 좀-
Overture to Despair#065.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#066.src: No. Just let us buy the cheapest stuff you have.
Overture to Despair#066.dst: 아니. 제일 싼 거 사게만 해 줘.
Overture to Despair#066.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#067.src: Uh huh... well, alright. If you insist...
Overture to Despair#067.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#068.src: Here, the cheapest I have available. In total, that will cost you... {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#068.dst: 여기, 제일 싼 것들이에요. 전부 해서... {~} EB입니다.
Overture to Despair#068.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#069.src: Very well. Here you are. Now, please leave, your attitude is not good for business!
Overture to Despair#069.dst: 좋아요. 여기 있습니다. 그럼 나가 주세요, 그 태도는 장사에 안 좋아요!
Overture to Despair#069.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#070.src: Okay... that's the clothes. Now we just... need a place to, um, stay. A hotel, maybe...
Overture to Despair#070.dst: 좋아... 옷은 해결. 이제... 묵을 곳만, 음, 있으면 돼. 호텔 같은...
Overture to Despair#070.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#071.src: Well! As I said, fashion is not cheap!
Overture to Despair#071.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#072.src: Ah, you're back. As I said, the clothes will cost you {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#072.dst: 아, 다시 오셨네요. 말씀드렸듯이 옷값은 {~} EB예요.
Overture to Despair#072.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#074.src: Ah... Listen, I still need to sell all of my stock, or I won't receive my bonus!
Overture to Despair#074.dst: 아... 저기요, 재고를 다 팔아야 보너스를 받는다고요!
Overture to Despair#074.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#075.src: So, unless you're interested in buying more clothes... please, leave.
Overture to Despair#075.dst: 그러니 옷을 더 사실 게 아니면... 제발 나가 주세요.
Overture to Despair#075.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#077.src: Why, hello and welcome to the Crown Jewel! How may I assist you?
Overture to Despair#077.dst: 어머, 안녕하세요, 왕관의 보석에 오신 걸 환영합니다! 무엇을 도와드릴까요?
Overture to Despair#077.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#079.src: Well, do you have a booking?
Overture to Despair#079.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#081.src: Hm I see. In that case, allow me to quickly check out listings...
Overture to Despair#081.dst: 흠, 그렇군요. 그럼 빈방을 빠르게 확인해 보겠습니다...
Overture to Despair#081.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#082.src: Aha! You're in luck! It seems we have a spare double room available! But that may not last long- let me tell you, they are selling fast!
Overture to Despair#082.dst: 아하! 운이 좋으시네요! 2인실이 하나 남아 있어요! 하지만 오래가진 않을걸요- 정말 빨리 나가거든요!
Overture to Despair#082.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#083.src: A... bigger room? You're certain? From where I stand, I only see the two of you, and-
Overture to Despair#083.dst: 더... 큰 방이요? 확실하세요? 제가 보기엔 두 분뿐인데요-
Overture to Despair#083.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#084.src: We're... going to have friends with us. They just... haven't, um, arrived yet.
Overture to Despair#084.dst: 우리... 친구들이 올 거야. 아직, 음, 도착을 안 했을 뿐이야.
Overture to Despair#084.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#085.src: I see. I see That certainly complicates things...
Overture to Despair#085.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#086.src: Company? Well, whatever sort? If you're just looking to socialize, the double room should serve your purposes well en-
Overture to Despair#086.dst: 일행이요? 어떤 분들이죠? 그냥 어울리실 거라면 2인실로도 충분할 텐-
Overture to Despair#086.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#087.src: No, they'll... be staying with us.
Overture to Despair#087.dst: 아니, 그 사람들도... 같이 묵을 거야.
Overture to Despair#087.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#088.src: Mmn. Yes, that would certainly put a damper on things. Hm...
Overture to Despair#088.dst: 음. 네, 그건 확실히 곤란하네요. 흠...
Overture to Despair#088.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#089.src: Well. I suppose we do also have the luxury suite available. Though, it's quite the hefty price...
Overture to Despair#089.dst: 그럼. 스위트룸도 비어 있긴 해요. 다만, 가격이 꽤 셉니다...

Overture to Despair#090.src: We- we'll take it. I'll pay.

Overture to Despair#095.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#096.dst: 아니. 우린... 놀러 온 게 아니야, {u}. 우린... 우린... 친구들을 구하러 왔어.
Overture to Despair#096.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#097.src: I'm, um... not hungry. And I'm, ha, definitely not in the mood for a drink.

Overture to Despair#097.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#098.src: ...you can, um, take a look around though. If- if you want. Just... don't take too long.
Overture to Despair#098.dst: ...그래도 넌, 음, 둘러봐도 돼. 워- 원한다면. 그냥... 너무 오래 걸리진 마.
Overture to Despair#098.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#099.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#100.dst: 방으로 가서 다음에 할 일을 의논하세요.

Overture to Despair#101.src: Ah! What can I do for you today?
Overture to Despair#101.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#102.dst: {p}은(는) 경치 좋은 산책로와 등산로로 유명해요! 호수 주변을 걷거나 산에 오르는 걸 추천드려요.

Overture to Despair#103.src: {p} is also known for their very rich alcohol culture. We brew a lot of different beverages that can be enjoyed at our local taverns.
Overture to Despair#103.dst: {p}은(는) 풍부한 술 문화로도 유명해요. 여러 술을 빚어서 동네 술집에서 즐길 수 있답니다.
Overture to Despair#103.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#104.src: We are not hosting any particular events at this moment because of the upcoming festival.
Overture to Despair#104.dst: 다가오는 축제 때문에 지금은 특별한 행사를 열지 않고 있어요.

Overture to Despair#105.src: Usually, we host game nights and quizzes in our bar!
Overture to Despair#105.dst: 평소엔 바에서 게임의 밤이랑 퀴즈 대회를 열어요!
Overture to Despair#105.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#106.src: Oh, are things not up to your standard?
Overture to Despair#106.dst: 아, 기대에 못 미치는 점이 있으신가요?
Overture to Despair#106.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#107.src: What have you experienced issues with?
Overture to Despair#107.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#108.src: I apologise for that! We will send in a cleaner later to fluff em up for ya!
Overture to Despair#108.dst: 죄송합니다! 나중에 청소 담당을 보내서 푹신하게 해 드릴게요!
Overture to Despair#108.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#110.src: Oh I will let our cleaners know to do a better job.
Overture to Despair#110.dst: 아, 청소 담당에게 더 꼼꼼히 하라고 전할게요.
Overture to Despair#110.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#112.src: Unfortunately there is nothing we can do to help with that.
Overture to Despair#112.dst: 안타깝게도 그 부분은 저희가 도와드릴 수가 없네요.
Overture to Despair#112.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#114.src: Let me know if there's anything I can do to make your stay better!
Overture to Despair#114.dst: 더 편히 묵으실 수 있게 필요한 게 있으면 말씀해 주세요!
Overture to Despair#114.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#116.src: A year of saving... f-finally payed off!
Overture to Despair#116.dst: 1년 모은 돈이... 드, 드디어 보람이 있네!
Overture to Despair#116.speaker: Timasca Tourist

Overture to Despair#117.src: A... a giant meal, and a nice hotel... and I have it all to m-myself!! Best! Week!! Ever!!
Overture to Despair#117.dst: 푸... 푸짐한 식사에, 좋은 호텔... 전부 나, 나 혼자 차지야!! 최고의! 일주일!!
Overture to Despair#117.speaker: Timasca Tourist

Overture to Despair#121.src: ...I had heard that about the Auburn Festival!
Overture to Despair#121.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#122.src: I can't say I expected word to reach {p} from over there. Though, let me say... so far, I am very impressed by how {p} handles festivities.
Overture to Despair#122.dst: 거기서 {p}까지 소문이 날 줄은 몰랐네요. 그래도 말이죠... 지금까지 {p}의 축제 운영엔 정말 감탄했어요.
Overture to Despair#122.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#123.src: Why, the real festivities haven't even begun! You're in for a treat, my friend.
Overture to Despair#123.dst: 어머, 진짜 축제는 시작도 안 했어요! 기대하셔도 좋아요, 친구.
Overture to Despair#123.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#124.src: ...by chance, would you let me show you around when the festival starts in full? I've enjoyed our talks so far.
Overture to Despair#124.dst: ...혹시, 축제가 본격적으로 시작되면 제가 안내해 드려도 될까요? 대화가 즐거웠거든요.
Overture to Despair#124.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#125.src: I'd love that. I've never been outside the {p} before... so it would be nice to have someone to guide me, wouldn't it?
Overture to Despair#125.dst: 좋아요. {p} 밖으로는 나가 본 적이 없어서... 안내해 줄 사람이 있으면 좋겠네요.
Overture to Despair#125.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#127.src: Ah, I'm so glad we meet again!
Overture to Despair#127.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#128.src: Even though you... barged into my room... er, isn't that against hotel policy?
Overture to Despair#128.dst: 그런데... 제 방에 불쑥 들어오시다니... 어, 호텔 규정 위반 아닌가요?
Overture to Despair#128.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#129.src: ...oh, well, I won't tell them. You did help me pay for the room, after all! I wish you all the best.
Overture to Despair#129.dst: ...아, 뭐, 말 안 할게요. 어쨌든 방값을 도와주셨으니까요! 잘되시길 빌어요.
Overture to Despair#129.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#130.src: Maybe we'll meet again! Perhaps I could buy you a drink at the festival?
Overture to Despair#130.dst: 또 만날지도 모르죠! 축제 때 한잔 사 드릴까요?
Overture to Despair#130.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#131.src: ...oh, you're here. Are you done looking around?
Overture to Despair#131.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#132.src: So, um. I've been... planning our next steps. Finding a place to stay was... a good idea, I guess. You were right. I shouldn't... rush into it.
Overture to Despair#132.dst: 그래서, 음. 나... 다음 단계를 계획하고 있었어. 묵을 곳을 찾은 건... 좋은 생각이었나 봐. 네 말이 맞았어. 서두르면... 안 돼.
Overture to Despair#132.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#133.src: But this is a good place to regroup once we... once we get Rex and Zeph back. We should, ha, act as early as possible, though.
Overture to Despair#133.dst: 그래도 여긴... Rex랑 Zeph를 되찾고 나서 다시 모이기 좋은 곳이야. 그래도, 하, 최대한 빨리 움직여야 해.
Overture to Despair#133.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#134.src: Stop that. You k-keep doing that, acting as if... a-as if the worst is inevitable! It's not helpful!
Overture to Despair#134.dst: 그만해. 너 계, 계속 그러잖아... 최, 최악이 피할 수 없는 것처럼! 도움이 안 돼!
Overture to Despair#134.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#135.src: Well... don't!! I know already, I know they might be gone, but I- I can't think like that. I can't. I have to believe they're still... fighting!!
Overture to Despair#135.dst: 그러니까... 하지 마!! 나도 알아, 둘이 없을지도 모른다는 거, 하지만 나- 난 그렇게 생각 못 해. 못 해. 아직... 버티고 있다고 믿어야 해!!
Overture to Despair#135.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#136.src: ...um. Anyway, we should... l-look around the town. To try and figure out where they're being held. If we can figure that out, then...
Overture to Despair#136.dst: ...음. 아무튼, 우리... 마, 마을을 둘러봐야 해. 둘이 어디 갇혀 있는지 알아내야지. 그걸 알아내면...
Overture to Despair#136.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#137.src: Look around the town, I guess... try and figure out where that Sovereign is keeping them. If we can figure that out, then... we can save them.
Overture to Despair#137.dst: 마을을 둘러보자... 군주가 둘을 어디 가둬 뒀는지 알아내야 해. 그걸 알아내면... 구할 수 있어.
Overture to Despair#137.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#138.src: We should start right away. Come on.
Overture to Despair#138.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#139.src: I can't, I can't, I can't. If I stop for... for even a second, I'll... I'll shatter. I have to keep moving. I have to.
Overture to Despair#139.dst: 못 해, 못 해, 못 해. 잠깐... 잠깐이라도 멈추면, 난... 난 산산조각 날 거야. 계속 움직여야 해. 그래야 해.
Overture to Despair#139.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#140.src: What do you think?! NO, I'm not doing alright!! But I have to do something about it, or... or... I'll shatter.
Overture to Despair#140.dst: 어떨 것 같은데?! 아니, 안 괜찮아!! 하지만 뭐라도 해야 해, 안 그러면... 안 그러면... 산산조각 날 거야.
Overture to Despair#140.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#141.src: You can... stay here and rest if you, um, need to. But I'm going to search the city for clues. By myself if... if I have to.
Overture to Despair#141.dst: 넌... 여기서 쉬어도 돼, 음, 필요하면. 하지만 난 도시에서 단서를 찾을 거야. 필요하면... 혼자서라도.
Overture to Despair#141.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#143.src: Meet up with Sui outside the Crown Jewel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Overture to Despair#143.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 있는 왕관의 보석 밖에서 Sui와 만나세요.

Overture to Despair#145.src: This... this wind chime. Look at it.
Overture to Despair#145.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#146.src: ...what? No, I'm looking at a wall. What do you think I was looking at?
Overture to Despair#146.dst: ...뭐? 아니, 벽 보고 있었어. 내가 뭘 보고 있는 줄 알았는데?
Overture to Despair#146.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#147.src: These wind chimes. They're... a symbol of resistance in the {p}. S... um, Syndra told us about them.
Overture to Despair#147.dst: 이 풍경종들. 이건... {p}의 저항의 상징이야. S... 음, Syndra가 알려 줬어.
Overture to Despair#147.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#148.src: The wind represents... freedom, and free will. But I wouldn't have expected the chimes to have made it all the way here...?
Overture to Despair#148.dst: 바람은... 자유, 그리고 자유 의지를 뜻해. 그런데 이 풍경종이 여기까지 퍼졌을 줄은 몰랐는데...?
Overture to Despair#148.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#149.src: Could... could this mean what I think it does?
Overture to Despair#149.dst: 이거... 이거 내가 생각하는 그 뜻일까?
Overture to Despair#149.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#150.src: I was right... I was right! It's a symbol of resistance, th-that means {p} must have its own resistance!!
Overture to Despair#150.dst: 내 말이 맞았어... 맞았다고! 저항의 상징이라는 건, {p}에도 저, 저항군이 있다는 뜻이야!!
Overture to Despair#150.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#151.src: We... we need to seek them out, {u}!
Overture to Despair#151.dst: 우리... 우리 그 사람들을 찾아야 해, {u}!
Overture to Despair#151.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#152.src: ...oh. Right. Um, sorry. I just... got excited.
Overture to Despair#152.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#153.src: ...oh. Oops. Let's um, hope I wasn't too loud...
Overture to Despair#153.dst: ...아. 이런. 음, 너무 크게 말하지 않았길...
Overture to Despair#153.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#154.src: A-anyway. I think there's... an inscription on the wind chime.
Overture to Despair#154.dst: 아, 아무튼. 풍경종에... 글이 새겨져 있는 것 같아.
Overture to Despair#154.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#155.src: "The winds of change blow from the west, crashing waves of truth unto our shores."
Overture to Despair#155.dst: "변화의 바람이 서쪽에서 불어와, 진실의 파도를 우리 해안에 부순다."
Overture to Despair#155.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#156.src: ...that must be where the resistance is! Let's- let's find them!
Overture to Despair#156.dst: ...거기가 저항군이 있는 곳이야! 가- 가서 찾자!
Overture to Despair#156.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#157.src: Find the location specified on the wind chime in {p}: The winds of change blow from the west, crashing waves of truth unto our shores.
Overture to Despair#157.dst: {p}에서 풍경종에 적힌 장소를 찾으세요: 변화의 바람이 서쪽에서 불어와, 진실의 파도를 우리 해안에 부순다.

Overture to Despair#158.src: ...oh. There... doesn't seem to be a resistance here. Just another wind chime.
Overture to Despair#158.dst: ...아. 여긴... 저항군이 없나 봐. 풍경종이 하나 더 있을 뿐이야.
Overture to Despair#158.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#159.src: Does this one also have something written on it?
Overture to Despair#159.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#160.src: Find the next location: Rooted deep atop the house of wealth and greed, the branches hear the whispers on the breeze.
Overture to Despair#160.dst: 다음 장소를 찾으세요: 부와 탐욕의 집 꼭대기에 깊이 뿌리내린 가지가 바람결의 속삭임을 듣는다.

Overture to Despair#161.src: Find the next location: The whispers speak of unity, called forth where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel.
Overture to Despair#161.dst: 다음 장소를 찾으세요: 속삭임은 단결을 말하니, 땅에 묻힌 강철 선으로 지역들이 만나는 곳에서 불려 나온다.

Overture to Despair#162.src: Find the next location: Day after day, the voices greet the seekers. Identify the truth, and read the secrets printed.
Overture to Despair#162.dst: 다음 장소를 찾으세요: 날마다 목소리들이 찾는 이를 맞이한다. 진실을 가려내고, 인쇄된 비밀을 읽어라.

Overture to Despair#163.src: Hello, hello! Care to buy any of our fine papers? Perhaps a magazine is up your alley today- quite the juicy bits of gossip I've heard.
Overture to Despair#163.dst: 안녕하세요, 안녕하세요! 좋은 신문 한 부 어떠세요? 오늘은 잡지가 끌리시려나- 꽤 짭짤한 소문이 있거든요.
Overture to Despair#163.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#164.src: What? {u}, what are you doing? That's not...
Overture to Despair#164.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#165.src: ...um. We're very interested in your... um, your wind chimes.
Overture to Despair#165.dst: ...음. 우린 당신의... 음, 풍경종에 아주 관심이 많아.
Overture to Despair#165.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#166.src: Windchimes? I'm sorry? I haven't the foggiest idea what you mean. I've certainly heard of them down in the {p}, but here? What an odd thing to say.
Overture to Despair#166.dst: 풍경종이요? 뭐라고요? 무슨 말씀인지 전혀 모르겠네요. {p} 쪽에 그런 게 있다고는 들었지만, 여기서요? 참 이상한 말씀이네요.
Overture to Despair#166.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#167.src: But still, perhaps I can get you a paper. Out of curiosity... where might you two be from? I don't think I've seen you around here before!
Overture to Despair#167.dst: 그래도 신문 한 부 어떠세요. 그런데 궁금해서 그러는데... 두 분은 어디서 오셨어요? 이 근처에선 못 뵌 것 같은데!
Overture to Despair#167.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#168.src: Haha, oh dear. I asked where you were from, not the way you got here. So, let's try that one again! Where are you two from?
Overture to Despair#168.dst: 하하, 이런. 어디서 왔냐고 물었지, 어떻게 왔냐고 물은 게 아니에요. 그러니 다시 한번! 두 분은 어디 출신이세요?
Overture to Despair#168.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#169.src: Ah, yes, and I found a gold bar in my mailbox today! Haha, you'll have to try harder to pull one over on me like that- no one's lived in the {p} for ages! Now, be serious! I was genuine in asking.
Overture to Despair#169.dst: 아, 네, 전 오늘 우편함에서 금괴를 주웠답니다! 하하, 그렇게 속이려면 더 노력하셔야죠- {p}엔 오래전부터 아무도 안 살아요! 자, 진지하게요! 진심으로 물어본 거예요.
Overture to Despair#169.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#170.src: So too we all do- from nothing but milk and love, as I've heard it's said, but if we were to talk about the origins of the universe we'd be here all night. So, where are you really from?

Overture to Despair#240.src: All of us... Rex, Zeph, the- the Roughworks boys... um, Mora, a-and Syndra... we were all laughing and, and having a good time at the Auburn Festival.
Overture to Despair#240.dst: 우리 모두... Rex, Zeph, 그- Roughworks 애들... 음, Mora, 그, 그리고 Syndra... 다 같이 Auburn 축제에서 웃으면서 즐겁게 놀고 있었어.
Overture to Despair#240.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#241.src: We ate good food... Yuman played music, while Rex and Zeph were b-bickering... Yusanu and Mora were t-talking about his latest invention, and...
Overture to Despair#241.dst: 맛있는 걸 먹고... Yuman은 연주하고, Rex랑 Zeph는 티, 티격태격하고... Yusanu랑 Mora는 그 애 새 발명품 얘, 얘기를 하고...
Overture to Despair#241.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#243.src: When I... when I woke up, I- ha, I was c-crying. I- I know, I know! It's... stupid. It's stupid.
Overture to Despair#243.dst: 깨어나 보니... 나- 하, 울, 울고 있더라. 아- 알아, 안다고! 바보 같지. 바보 같아.
Overture to Despair#243.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#244.src: ...it's, um, hard to pick out one moment. She's been like a mother to me ever since I was... {~} years old.
Overture to Despair#244.dst: ...음, 한 순간만 고르긴 어려워. {~}살 때부터... 나한테 엄마 같은 사람이었거든.
Overture to Despair#244.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#245.src: M-maybe the first time I really met her. After I discovered my... my gift, I thought my life was over.
Overture to Despair#245.dst: 아, 아마 처음 제대로 만났을 때. 내... 내 능력을 알게 된 뒤로, 내 인생은 끝났다고 생각했어.
Overture to Despair#245.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#246.src: I- I was cursed! And I knew what h-happened to the cursed. Taken away, never to be seen again... or, or killed outright. I had nowhere to go.
Overture to Despair#246.dst: 나- 난 저주받았어! 저주받은 자가 어, 어떻게 되는지 알았고. 끌려가서 다신 안 나타나거나... 그냥 죽거나. 갈 곳이 없었어.
Overture to Despair#246.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#247.src: I, um... I'd seen Syndra around before. I... I knew she talked to Mora, before he... l-left our family. So... I, ha, I guess I thought... maybe she'd help me too.
Overture to Despair#247.dst: 난, 음... 전에 Syndra를 본 적이 있었어. Mora가... 떠, 떠나기 전에 그녀랑 얘기한 것도 알았고. 그래서... 하, 아마 생각했나 봐... 나도 도와주지 않을까.
Overture to Despair#247.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#248.src: A-and she did! She wasn't scared, she didn't report me. She just... embraced me in a hug and welcome me to her home.
Overture to Despair#248.dst: 그, 그리고 도와줬어! 무서워하지도, 신고하지도 않았어. 그냥... 날 안아 주고 자기 집에 맞아 줬어.
Overture to Despair#248.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#249.src: She, um, reunited me with Mora again. After... f-five long years alone. She... she saved me, and now... and now she's...
Overture to Despair#249.dst: 그리고, 음, Mora랑 다시 만나게 해 줬어. 호, 혼자였던 긴 5년 끝에. 날... 구해 줬는데, 이젠... 이젠...
Overture to Despair#249.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#250.src: ...I never got to tell her how much she meant to me.
Overture to Despair#250.dst: ...나한테 얼마나 소중한 사람인지 끝내 말 못 했어.
Overture to Despair#250.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#254.src: Return to the newspaper shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Overture to Despair#256.src: Oh, is it night time already...? We should get back to the newspaper merchant then.
Overture to Despair#256.dst: 아, 벌써 밤이야...? 그럼 신문 상인한테 돌아가자.
Overture to Despair#256.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#257.src: {u}, before we head in. Let's just... observe, a-and not ask too many questions.
Overture to Despair#257.dst: {u}, 들어가기 전에. 그냥... 지켜보자, 그, 그리고 질문은 너무 많이 하지 말고.
Overture to Despair#257.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#258.src: Ah, terribly sorry! We're just closing out for the day was on my way out the door. Oh did you find the paper to be enlightening?
Overture to Despair#258.dst: 아, 정말 죄송해요! 오늘은 막 문 닫고 나가려던 참이에요. 아, 신문은 도움이 되셨나요?
Overture to Despair#258.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#259.src: No such thing as a green Squirmle Pot.
Overture to Despair#259.dst: 초록색 Squirmle Pot 같은 건 없다.
Overture to Despair#259.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#260.src: Good, good! Glad to hear you're interested in cutting through the weeds, hearing the stories that matter.
Overture to Despair#260.dst: 좋아요, 좋아요! 잡초를 헤치고 중요한 이야기를 듣는 데 관심이 있으시다니 기쁘네요.
Overture to Despair#260.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#261.src: The meeting will be shortly starting- take the stairs behind me, and head downwards.
Overture to Despair#261.dst: 모임이 곧 시작돼요- 제 뒤의 계단으로 내려가세요.
Overture to Despair#261.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#262.src: The meeting will be shortly starting- take the stairs behind me, and head downwards.
Overture to Despair#262.dst: 모임이 곧 시작돼요- 제 뒤의 계단으로 내려가세요.
Overture to Despair#262.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#263.src: That ought to be all of us. Let's begin, everyone!
Overture to Despair#263.dst: 다 모인 것 같네요. 여러분, 시작하죠!
Overture to Despair#263.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#264.src: We have some new members joining us today. Please welcome them to our society, The Blossom of Blades.
Overture to Despair#264.dst: 오늘 새 회원들이 왔어요. 우리 모임, 칼날의 꽃에 오신 걸 환영해 주세요.
Overture to Despair#264.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#265.src: Now, Bleeding Rose. You were so excited to start us off earlier. You've been so quiet normally- how about you share first today?
Overture to Despair#265.dst: 자, 피 흘리는 장미. 아까 먼저 말하고 싶어 했죠. 평소엔 조용했는데- 오늘은 먼저 해 볼래요?
Overture to Despair#265.speaker: Resistance Member

Overture to Despair#266.src: ...thank you, Dusk Garden. I...I think this is pretty alarming, actually... Comparing the prices day to day, bread suddenly spiked. {~} more than just a week ago, with no word of warning.
Overture to Despair#266.dst: ...고마워요, 황혼 정원. 저... 저는 이게 꽤 심각하다고 봐요... 매일 가격을 비교해 보니 빵값이 갑자기 뛰었어요. 불과 일주일 전보다 {~} 올랐는데, 아무 예고도 없었어요.
Overture to Despair#266.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#267.src: I'm not sure what we can...really do about that, but shouldn't we...y-y'know... ... ...do... ...something...?
Overture to Despair#267.dst: 그걸 어떻게... 할 수 있을진 모르겠지만, 우리가... 그, 그러니까... ... ...뭔가... ...해야 하지 않을까요...?
Overture to Despair#267.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#268.src: Ugh, again? It isn't an unlivable increase yet, but the poorer among us will definitely be feeling that. Thank you for speaking up, now it's someone else's turn.
Overture to Despair#268.dst: 으, 또요? 아직 못 살 정도는 아니지만, 우리 중 가난한 사람들은 확실히 체감하겠네요. 말해 줘서 고마워요, 이제 다른 사람 차례예요.
Overture to Despair#268.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#270.src: Psst. What the hell is going on here?
Overture to Despair#270.dst: 쉿. 대체 여기 뭐 하는 거야?
Overture to Despair#270.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#272.src: Oh, oh! The news from {p}!! It's- well, I don't know if it's a disaster, or a good thing, really!
Overture to Despair#272.dst: 아, 아! {p} 소식!! 그게- 음, 재앙인지 좋은 일인지 모르겠어요!
Overture to Despair#272.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#273.src: Well, I barely had time to read the Aelumia Times to get the passcode. Fill me in, would you?
Overture to Despair#273.dst: 난 암호 보려고 Aelumia 타임스 읽을 시간도 겨우 났어요. 좀 알려 줄래요?
Overture to Despair#273.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#274.src: This wasn't in the Aelumia Times... Anonymous sources have stated that Sovereign Soosu defied Her Majesty, openly!!
Overture to Despair#274.dst: Aelumia 타임스엔 안 나왔어요... 익명의 소식통에 따르면 Soosu 군주가 여왕 폐하께 대놓고 반기를 들었대요!!
Overture to Despair#274.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#276.src: What- What do you mean?! Defied, like...went off-script during a speech, or-
Overture to Despair#276.dst: 뭐- 무슨 말이에요?! 반기라니... 연설 중에 원고를 벗어났다거나-
Overture to Despair#276.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#277.src: She allowed terrorists to escape! At least three of them, according to my sources! Word is, too, that... That she was... Executed!!
Overture to Despair#277.dst: 테러리스트를 놓아줬대요! 제 소식통 말로는 적어도 셋이요! 그리고 소문엔... 그녀가... 처형당했대요!!
Overture to Despair#277.speaker: Thorn Blade

Overture to Despair#278.src: I- You guys! A Sovereign went against the Queen! What...what do you think that means, for us? what do you think we should do? If she can do something that big-
Overture to Despair#278.dst: 저- 여러분! 군주가 여왕에게 맞섰어요! 그게... 우리한테 무슨 의미일까요? 우린 어떻게 해야 할까요? 그녀가 그렇게 큰일을 할 수 있다면-
Overture to Despair#278.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#279.src: And get executed for it?! Then who would do the work we do? Soosu has always been a bit of a loose cannon anyways. It isn't that surprising.
Overture to Despair#279.dst: 그리고 그래서 처형당하라고요?! 그럼 우리 일은 누가 해요? Soosu는 원래 좀 통제 불능이었어요. 그리 놀랄 일도 아니죠.
Overture to Despair#279.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#281.src: In other news! Sovereign Majin was supposedly seen with an unknown man this Saturday. They were out on a walk, but we all know what that really means.
Overture to Despair#281.dst: 다른 소식이요! Majin 군주가 이번 토요일에 정체불명의 남자와 함께 있는 게 목격됐대요. 산책 중이었다지만, 다들 무슨 뜻인지 알잖아요.
Overture to Despair#281.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#282.src: -up for you next time, Rose- Ah. That- I heard that was just a new servant. Nothing too important.
Overture to Despair#282.dst: -다음엔 꼭 말하게 해 줄게요, Rose- 아. 그거- 그냥 새 하인이라던데요. 별로 중요한 건 아니에요.
Overture to Despair#282.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#283.src: Well, I'll be publishing it in the Majin Monthly anyways. Maybe I could spin a scandal out of this one! ...probably not, but you never know.
Overture to Despair#283.dst: 뭐, 어쨌든 Majin 월간지에 실을 거예요. 이걸로 스캔들 하나 만들어 볼 수도 있겠죠! ...아마 안 되겠지만, 모르는 일이잖아요.
Overture to Despair#283.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#284.src: Um... I actually had a question about Sovereign Majin.
Overture to Despair#284.dst: 음... 사실 Majin 군주에 대해 물어볼 게 있어.
Overture to Despair#284.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#285.src: Oh, absolutely! I keep tabs on him, so you could consider me an expert on all things Majin, uh...miss...what was your code name again?
Overture to Despair#285.dst: 아, 물론이죠! 제가 그 사람을 계속 주시하고 있으니 Majin에 대해선 전문가라고 보시면 돼요, 어... 아가씨... 코드명이 뭐였죠?
Overture to Despair#285.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#286.src: Oh, my... code... name... um. Right. It's- Water Grass. That's my name.
Overture to Despair#286.dst: 아, 내... 코드... 네임... 음. 맞다. 그건- 물풀. 그게 내 이름이야.
Overture to Despair#286.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#287.src: ...alright. That... That doesn't follow our naming scheme perfectly but- You know, whatever. What's your question?
Overture to Despair#287.dst: ...그래요. 그건... 우리 작명 규칙에 딱 맞진 않지만- 뭐, 됐어요. 질문이 뭐예요?
Overture to Despair#287.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#288.src: I... um, I heard a rumor that he'd picked up some prisoners from the {p}.
Overture to Despair#288.dst: 난... 음, 그가 {p}에서 죄수 몇 명을 데려갔다는 소문을 들었어.
Overture to Despair#288.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#289.src: Ah! You spoiled my juicy scoop for tomorrow's edition! Yes, the rumour is true.
Overture to Despair#289.dst: 아! 내일 호에 실을 특종을 망치셨네! 네, 그 소문 사실이에요.
Overture to Despair#289.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#290.src: Supposedly, he took these prisoners to his castle in the east. There is, according to other rumour, a dungeon underneath it. It'd make sense- why wouldn't a dictator have a dungeon for dissidents?
Overture to Despair#290.dst: 듣자 하니 그 죄수들을 동쪽 자기 성으로 데려갔대요. 다른 소문으로는 성 아래에 지하 감옥이 있다고 하고요. 말이 되죠- 독재자라면 반대파용 지하 감옥 하나쯤 없겠어요?
Overture to Despair#290.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#291.src: R-really? What else do you know?
Overture to Despair#291.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#292.src: That there were specifically two prisoners, and, to bring it back around to Thorn Blade's news, that they're part of the {p} Terrorists! Because of that, the guard around House Thalas is particularly tight recently.
Overture to Despair#292.dst: 죄수는 정확히 두 명이고, 가시 칼날의 소식으로 돌아가자면, {p} 테러리스트 일당이래요! 그래서 요즘 Thalas 가문 주변 경비가 유난히 삼엄해요.
Overture to Despair#292.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#293.src: Incidentally, I was planning on selling this piece to the Aelumia Times. So, don't any of you go writing in before me.
Overture to Despair#293.dst: 그나저나 이 기사는 Aelumia 타임스에 팔 생각이었어요. 그러니 아무도 저보다 먼저 투고하지 마세요.
Overture to Despair#293.speaker: Violent Heather

Overture to Despair#294.src: Well, ah, I heard one of them was that runaway House Athassa girl! Remember the tabloids a few years ago? It was a whole scandal.
Overture to Despair#294.dst: 음, 저기, 그중 하나가 Athassa 가문에서 도망친 그 여자애래요! 몇 년 전 가십지 기억나요? 완전 스캔들이었잖아요.
Overture to Despair#294.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#295.src: Goodness, Boundless Cherry's sister? I hadn't realized she was involved! Tsk, what a shame that reason doesn't run in the family.
Overture to Despair#295.dst: 세상에, 끝없는 벚꽃의 여동생이요? 그 애도 연루된 줄은 몰랐네요! 쯧, 분별력은 집안 내력이 아닌가 봐요.
Overture to Despair#295.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#296.src: What does it matter?! You never shut up about the "one that got away," and- and there's so much more important to b-
Overture to Despair#296.dst: 그게 무슨 상관이에요?! 맨날 '놓친 그 사람' 얘기만 하고- 훨씬 더 중요한 일이 많은데-
Overture to Despair#296.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#297.src: I do not! Crimson Dagger, please, back me up-
Overture to Despair#297.dst: 안 그래요! 진홍 단검, 제발 내 편 좀 들어 줘요-
Overture to Despair#297.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#298.src: What are we going to DO?! We just- I came here because I thought together we-
Overture to Despair#298.dst: 우린 대체 뭘 '할' 건데요?! 우린 그냥- 함께라면 뭔가 할 수 있을 줄 알고 왔는데-
Overture to Despair#298.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#299.src: Ah! Ah ah!! Did you guys hear that we aren't getting any freebies this festival? This is absolutely appalling.
Overture to Despair#299.dst: 아! 아, 아!! 이번 축제엔 공짜 선물이 없다는 얘기 들었어요? 정말 어처구니가 없어요.
Overture to Despair#299.speaker: Wilted Camellia

Overture to Despair#302.src: ...shoot! Me and... um, Shadow Bush... forgot to turn off the stove! We'll, um, see you guys at the next meeting! May we reveal secrets buried and bring change!
Overture to Despair#302.dst: ...이런! 나랑... 음, 그림자 덤불이... 가스 불을 안 끄고 왔어! 우리, 음, 다음 모임 때 봐! 묻힌 비밀을 드러내어 변화를 일으키기를!
Overture to Despair#302.speaker: "Water Grass"

Overture to Despair#303.src: Uhm- it's "May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change..." People never get it right-
Overture to Despair#303.dst: 어- '오래 묻힌 진실을 파내어 변화를 일으키기를'인데요... 다들 맨날 틀려요-
Overture to Despair#303.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#304.src: She's going to do something! I, I know she's going to- I have to- Guys, can't you see th-
Overture to Despair#304.dst: 그녀가 뭔가 하려는 거예요! 저, 저는 알아요, 그녀가- 저도 해야- 여러분, 안 보여요-
Overture to Despair#304.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#305.src: You don't know that! And if you try and convince her to, we won't be having you here anymore! Enough about this, do you have any kind of plan?
Overture to Despair#305.dst: 그걸 어떻게 알아요! 그리고 그녀를 부추기려 들면 더는 여기 못 있어요! 그만하고, 무슨 계획이라도 있어요?
Overture to Despair#305.speaker: Crimson Dagger

Overture to Despair#306.src: Every time I try and think of one, I get shut down! I know I don't have much, but...but, if we work toge-
Overture to Despair#306.dst: 하나라도 생각해 내려 할 때마다 막히잖아요! 가진 게 별로 없는 건 알지만... 그래도, 우리가 힘을 합-
Overture to Despair#306.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Overture to Despair#307.src: Enough of that already, Bleeding Rose! We can't reveal the secrets of the monarchy if we're imprisoned! And don't even try to say "what secrets?" This is big news!!
Overture to Despair#307.dst: 이제 그만해요, 피 흘리는 장미! 감옥에 갇히면 왕실의 비밀을 폭로할 수가 없잖아요! 그리고 '무슨 비밀?'이라고 하지도 마요. 이건 큰 뉴스라고요!!
Overture to Despair#307.speaker: Dusk Garden

Overture to Despair#308.src: Speak with Sui outside the Newspaper Shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#310.src: I... wanted to stay for the whole meeting. But after that, I... I couldn't.
Overture to Despair#310.dst: 나... 모임 끝까지 있고 싶었어. 근데 그 뒤로는... 도저히 못 있겠더라.
Overture to Despair#310.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#311.src: We know where they are. We know where to find them!
Overture to Despair#311.dst: 둘이 어디 있는지 알았어. 어디서 찾을지 안다고!
Overture to Despair#311.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#312.src: I didn't realize all their names would be so... weird and edgy. I had to come up with something! Just be glad it wasn't something worse, okay?
Overture to Despair#312.dst: 다들 이름이 그렇게... 이상하고 허세 가득할 줄 몰랐어. 뭐라도 지어내야 했다고! 더 심한 이름 아닌 걸 다행으로 여겨, 알았지?
Overture to Despair#312.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#313.src: Look. I had to think on the spot, okay! I just needed a way out.
Overture to Despair#313.dst: 봐. 즉석에서 생각해야 했다고, 알았어! 빠져나갈 핑계가 필요했을 뿐이야.
Overture to Despair#313.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#314.src: ...was that really it? That's the resistance group around here...?
Overture to Despair#314.dst: ...진짜 저게 다야? 저게 이 동네 저항군이라고...?
Overture to Despair#314.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#315.src: All they're doing is... is... is sitting around, gossiping about trivial problems! Like... like it's the end of the world!
Overture to Despair#315.dst: 하는 거라곤... 그냥... 그냥 앉아서 사소한 문제로 수다나 떨고! 무슨... 세상이 끝난 것처럼!
Overture to Despair#315.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#316.src: An increase in bread prices...? No freebies from the festival...? Who cares?! People are... p-people are dying!!
Overture to Despair#316.dst: 빵값이 오른다고...? 축제에 공짜 선물이 없다고...? 누가 신경 써?! 사람들이... 사, 사람들이 죽어 가는데!!
Overture to Despair#316.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#317.src: And... and the one person who was trying to do something kept... k-kept getting shut down... ugh! Why did I think something could f-finally go right...
Overture to Despair#317.dst: 그리고... 뭔가 하려던 유일한 사람은 계속... 계, 계속 입이 막히고... 으! 왜 드, 드디어 뭔가 잘될 거라고 생각했을까...
Overture to Despair#317.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#318.src: Whatever. At least their gossip got us some useful leads... we- we know for sure where Rex and Zeph are!
Overture to Despair#318.dst: 됐어. 적어도 그 수다 덕에 쓸 만한 단서는 얻었어... 우- 우린 Rex랑 Zeph가 어디 있는지 확실히 알아!
Overture to Despair#318.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#319.src: So... let's head to the castle, and- and take back our friends.
Overture to Despair#319.dst: 그러니까... 성으로 가서- 친구들을 되찾아 오자.
Overture to Despair#319.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#320.src: Violent Heather mentioned, um, a dungeon. That's probably where they're being kept... I- I can get them.
Overture to Despair#320.dst: 사나운 헤더가, 음, 지하 감옥 얘기를 했어. 아마 거기 갇혀 있을 거야... 내- 내가 데려올 수 있어.
Overture to Despair#320.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#321.src: But... if we just go in, then... there'll probably be too many guards to take out. We need a distraction.
Overture to Despair#321.dst: 하지만... 그냥 들어가면... 경비병이 너무 많아서 다 처리 못 할 거야. 주의를 돌릴 게 필요해.
Overture to Despair#321.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#322.src: Could you... draw their attention at the front gates? I, um, I know you're strong enough for it, so... could you do that?
Overture to Despair#322.dst: 네가... 정문에서 경비들 시선을 끌어 줄래? 난, 음, 네가 충분히 강하다는 거 알아, 그러니까... 해 줄 수 있어?
Overture to Despair#322.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#323.src: A-alright. Good. Good, good, good. Come on, let's save our friends!
Overture to Despair#323.dst: 조, 좋아. 잘됐다. 좋아, 좋아, 좋아. 가자, 친구들을 구하러!
Overture to Despair#323.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#324.src: Well... well, too bad. I need you to do it anyway. Come on.
Overture to Despair#324.dst: 음... 음, 안됐네. 그래도 네가 해 줘야 해. 가자.
Overture to Despair#324.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#325.src: Head the Majin's castle to the east at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#326.src: Come on, let's save our friends!
Overture to Despair#326.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#328.src: Oh, what I'd give to just... just... stick him full of spikes... ugh, but I can't.
Overture to Despair#328.dst: 아, 그냥... 그냥... 그 인간을 가시로 벌집을 만들 수만 있다면... 으, 안 돼.
Overture to Despair#328.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#329.src: I'll... search for them in the dungeons while you, um, cause a distraction.
Overture to Despair#329.dst: 난... 지하 감옥에서 둘을 찾을게. 넌, 음, 주의를 끌어 줘.
Overture to Despair#329.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#330.src: However you... um, do that. Storm the castle, or... or whatever. Just... stay safe.
Overture to Despair#330.dst: 방법은... 음, 네 마음대로 해. 성을 급습하든지... 뭐든지. 그냥... 몸조심해.
Overture to Despair#330.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#331.src: We'll meet back at the Crown Jewel once we're done. If... if either of us don't make it, then...
Overture to Despair#331.dst: 끝나면 왕관의 보석에서 다시 만나자. 만약... 우리 중 누가 못 돌아오면...
Overture to Despair#331.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#334.src: Okay... okay. L-let's get them back!
Overture to Despair#334.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#335.src: Okay. Y-yeah. Just... um, hurry back here once you are.
Overture to Despair#335.dst: 알았어. 으, 응. 그냥... 음, 준비되면 빨리 여기로 와.
Overture to Despair#335.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#336.src: Head the Majin's castle to the east at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#337.src: Oh my, but if it isn't the province's most wanted criminal, striding forth into my House entirely of your own volition! Her predictions are as accurate as ever, it would seem.
Overture to Despair#337.dst: 오호, 이게 누구신가, 이 지방 제일의 현상범께서 제 발로 내 가문에 성큼성큼 걸어 들어오시다니! 그분의 예측은 여전히 정확하시군.
Overture to Despair#337.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#338.src: Quite a foolish thing to do, if you ask me... though I do suppose you have proven yourself something of a wild card these past weeks!
Overture to Despair#338.dst: 내가 보기엔 꽤 어리석은 짓이다만... 하긴 지난 몇 주간 네가 꽤나 예측 불가한 패라는 건 증명했지!
Overture to Despair#338.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#339.src: But of course! We do hold the leverage here... you must have come in search of your dear imprisoned friends, haven't you?
Overture to Despair#339.dst: 물론이지! 칼자루는 우리가 쥐고 있으니... 갇혀 있는 소중한 친구들을 찾으러 온 거겠지, 아닌가?
Overture to Despair#339.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#340.src: What a simple lure... but effective, evidently! It has drawn you in, right where we want you.
Overture to Despair#340.dst: 참으로 단순한 미끼건만... 보아하니 효과는 있군! 우리가 원하는 자리로 널 끌어들였으니.
Overture to Despair#340.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#341.src: Oh, really! My my, I would have never guessed - to think, holding them captive might draw you in! What an astonishing revelation.
Overture to Despair#341.dst: 오, 그런가! 이런, 이런, 짐작도 못 했네 - 그들을 가둬 두면 네가 올지도 모른다니! 이 얼마나 놀라운 깨달음인가.
Overture to Despair#341.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#342.src: They are here, certainly. But you will not be seeing them. There are greater plans in motion, it would seem!
Overture to Despair#342.dst: 그들은 분명 여기 있다. 하지만 넌 못 만날 거야. 더 큰 계획이 움직이고 있는 모양이거든!
Overture to Despair#342.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#343.src: Fight you?! and ruin my decor? Ha! Ahahahaha! Goodness, no, of course not. If I were, you would already be dead.
Overture to Despair#343.dst: 너와 싸우라고?! 내 실내 장식을 망치면서? 하! 아하하하하! 맙소사, 당연히 아니지. 싸울 생각이었다면 넌 이미 죽었다.
Overture to Despair#343.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#344.src: Perhaps at some later date I might be more amenable to wiping the floor with you! But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
Overture to Despair#344.dst: 나중에 언젠가는 널 바닥에 짓뭉개 주는 데 좀 더 흔쾌할지도 모르지! 하지만 유감스럽게도 볼일이 있어서.
Overture to Despair#344.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#345.src: Oh, take that dour look off your face. Perhaps if all goes well, we might be willing to discuss returning those friends of yours! I certainly have no need to keep them.
Overture to Despair#345.dst: 오, 그 뚱한 표정 좀 치워라. 모든 게 잘 풀리면 네 친구들을 돌려주는 걸 논의해 볼 수도 있지! 나도 그들을 붙잡아 둘 이유는 없으니.
Overture to Despair#345.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#346.src: I mean, really, what use could I actually have had for those two? Waster my efforts pulling information out of them that I already know?
Overture to Despair#346.dst: 아니, 정말, 그 둘이 나한테 무슨 쓸모가 있었겠나? 이미 아는 정보를 캐내느라 헛수고나 하고?
Overture to Despair#346.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#347.src: It was pathetic, honestly. The two of them, sitting in front of me, sniveling like little babies...
Overture to Despair#347.dst: 솔직히 한심했지. 그 둘이 내 앞에 앉아서, 갓난아기처럼 훌쩍거리면서...
Overture to Despair#347.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#348.src: "Spare me, great Sovereign! Spare me, great Sovereign!"
Overture to Despair#348.dst: "살려 주십시오, 위대한 군주님! 살려 주십시오, 위대한 군주님!"
Overture to Despair#348.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#349.src: As if that would save them! Ha! Hahahahahaha!
Overture to Despair#349.dst: 그런다고 살 줄 알고! 하! 하하하하하하!
Overture to Despair#349.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#350.src: Oh, but what does it matter? They are not important, but you... it would seem Her Majesty has taken interest in you, heavens know why.
Overture to Despair#350.dst: 오, 그런데 그게 무슨 상관이지? 그들은 중요하지 않아. 하지만 너는... 여왕 폐하께서 관심을 두신 모양이더군, 이유는 하늘만 알겠지만.
Overture to Despair#350.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#351.src: But before that, seeing as you are a guest of honour here in House Thalas... allow me to lead you on a tour of the castle!
Overture to Despair#351.dst: 하지만 그 전에, 네가 이 Thalas 가문의 귀빈이니... 내가 직접 성을 안내해 주지!
Overture to Despair#351.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#352.src: You should feel honoured. Receiving such a personalized tour is quite an uncommon occurrence around here! Do feel free to write about it in your memoirs... if you ever get the chance.
Overture to Despair#352.dst: 영광으로 알아라. 이렇게 직접 안내받는 건 여기선 아주 드문 일이거든! 회고록에 마음껏 적어도 좋아... 그럴 기회가 온다면 말이지.
Overture to Despair#352.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#353.src: Oh no, dear guest, I'm afraid you are not. You do not have a choice in the matter, in fact!
Overture to Despair#353.dst: 오 이런, 친애하는 손님, 유감스럽게도 아니야. 사실 이 일엔 네 선택권이 없거든!
Overture to Despair#353.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#354.src: Oh, but I rather do insist! You've come this far, haven't you? And you're a guest of the House- it would be quite rude for you to decline.
Overture to Despair#354.dst: 오, 하지만 난 꼭 그래야겠는걸! 여기까지 왔잖나? 게다가 넌 가문의 손님이야- 거절하면 상당히 무례한 일이지.
Overture to Despair#354.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#355.src: So come along, now. There's much to see, much to do! And we wouldn't want to keep her waiting, would we?
Overture to Despair#355.dst: 그러니 자, 따라와. 볼 것도, 할 것도 많아! 그리고 그분을 기다리게 할 순 없지, 안 그래?
Overture to Despair#355.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#356.src: Oh, did I forget to mention? There's someone who would like to meet you! Our Spymaster has finally returned from abroad, and she has much to say to you.
Overture to Despair#356.dst: 오, 내가 말을 안 했던가? 널 만나고 싶어 하는 분이 계셔! 우리 첩보대장이 드디어 해외에서 돌아왔는데, 너한테 할 말이 많다더군.
Overture to Despair#356.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#357.src: Follow Majin on the tour of his castle at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#358.src: Now. To begin with, to your left you'll see my personal library!
Overture to Despair#358.dst: 자. 우선, 왼쪽에 보이는 게 내 개인 서재다!
Overture to Despair#358.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#359.src: I've amassed quite a large collection, you see. Numerous books written by famous writers from all over the province! Some of my personal work is also featured here.
Overture to Despair#359.dst: 보다시피 꽤 방대한 소장품을 모았지. 지방 곳곳의 유명 작가들이 쓴 수많은 책들! 내 작품도 몇 권 여기 있다네.
Overture to Despair#359.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#360.src: And straight ahead, we'll reach my secret, not-so-secret, tower of magical tomes and scrolls.
Overture to Despair#360.dst: 그리고 곧장 앞으로 가면, 비밀이지만 그리 비밀도 아닌, 마법서와 두루마리의 탑이 나오지.
Overture to Despair#360.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#361.src: Over the years, I've acquired much... hm, shall we say, "forbidden" literature of that variety. The Cursed simply will not stop trying, no matter how foolish the act!
Overture to Despair#361.dst: 수년간 그런 종류의... 흠, '금지된' 문헌을 꽤 손에 넣었지. 저주받은 자들은 아무리 어리석어도 도무지 포기를 안 하거든!
Overture to Despair#361.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#362.src: I'd say I have mastered... ah, about half of the spells and rituals featured here? It depends on your definitions- goodness knows the psionics have it rough.
Overture to Despair#362.dst: 여기 실린 주문과 의식의... 아, 절반쯤은 통달했다고 할까? 정의하기 나름이지만- 사이오닉은 정말 골치 아프거든.
Overture to Despair#362.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#363.src: Oh, good grief, don't play dumb. I know full well that you understand the term. You all out there in Wynn make great use of it, or so I've been told.
Overture to Despair#363.dst: 오, 맙소사, 모르는 척하지 마라. 네가 그 말을 안다는 건 뻔히 알아. 저기 Wynn에서는 아주 잘들 써먹는다고 들었거든.
Overture to Despair#363.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#364.src: It truly is a wonder you manage to get anything done out there! Where is the control, the coordination?! No, I much prefer how we handle things here in Fruma, thank you.
Overture to Despair#364.dst: 거기서 일이 돌아간다는 게 정말 기적이야! 통제는 어디 있고, 조율은 어디 있나?! 아니, 난 여기 Fruma의 방식이 훨씬 좋네, 사양하지.
Overture to Despair#364.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#365.src: Yes, the Psionics... old history, that is. Sometime during the RA years, I believe? They had been mistaken for the cursed, and were exterminated by the crown for it.
Overture to Despair#365.dst: 그래, 사이오닉... 옛날 역사지. RA 시대 언제쯤이었던가? 저주받은 자로 오인받아서 왕실에게 몰살당했어.
Overture to Despair#365.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#366.src: A mistake, if you ask me! Psionic abilities certainly should not be considered the same as magic, they're quite different in how they manifest... but alas, it is what it is.
Overture to Despair#366.dst: 내가 보기엔 실수였지! 사이오닉 능력은 마법과 같게 봐선 안 돼. 발현 방식이 전혀 다르거든... 하지만 뭐, 어쩌겠나.
Overture to Despair#366.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#367.src: Cursed?! Ha! Oh, no no no, I was not "cursed". I believe you and I both understand the meaninglessness of that terminology, hm?
Overture to Despair#367.dst: 저주?! 하! 오, 아니 아니 아니, 난 '저주받은' 적 없어. 그 용어가 얼마나 무의미한지 너도 나도 알잖나, 응?
Overture to Despair#367.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#368.src: Curses, blessings... a means of controlling the public. A rather useful one, at that - though I never did follow the rules.
Overture to Despair#368.dst: 저주, 축복... 대중을 통제하는 수단이지. 그것도 꽤 쓸모 있는 수단 - 물론 난 규칙을 따른 적이 없지만.
Overture to Despair#368.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#369.src: In the end, magic is but another way to obtain power over the weak... is it not natural to seek it out oneself, in order to achieve greatness?
Overture to Despair#369.dst: 결국 마법이란 약자를 지배하는 또 하나의 방법일 뿐... 위대해지려면 스스로 그걸 좇는 게 당연하지 않나?
Overture to Despair#369.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#370.src: I don't suppose you would understand. You don't seem the type to have ever reached such heights. Regardless, let us press onward!
Overture to Despair#370.dst: 넌 이해 못 하겠지. 그런 경지에 올라 본 적 있는 부류로는 안 보이니. 어쨌든, 계속 가자고!
Overture to Despair#370.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#371.src: Hm... I shall leave you to peruse my collections for the time being. The tour shall continue at the top of these stairs! Don't take too long, would you?
Overture to Despair#371.dst: 흠... 잠시 내 소장품을 둘러보도록 두지. 안내는 이 계단 꼭대기에서 계속된다! 너무 오래 걸리진 말게, 응?
Overture to Despair#371.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#372.src: Ah... this before you is my planetarium. Quite the marvel, don't you think? On my journey in developing my magical prowess, I developed quite the interest in the cosmos.
Overture to Despair#372.dst: 아... 네 앞에 있는 이것이 내 천체관이다. 대단하지 않나? 마법 실력을 갈고닦는 여정에서 우주에 꽤 관심이 생겼지.
Overture to Despair#372.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#373.src: It was this very room in which I discovered the comet which would be named after me! Majin's Comet... this year will be the third time I see its purple shine fly through the night sky.
Overture to Despair#373.dst: 바로 이 방에서 내 이름이 붙은 혜성을 발견했지! Majin 혜성... 올해 그 보랏빛이 밤하늘을 가르는 걸 세 번째로 보게 될 거다.
Overture to Despair#373.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#374.src: In truth, it fascinates me... the power and mystery lying dormant behind each and every star, just waiting to be tapped into!
Overture to Despair#374.dst: 사실 난 그게 매혹적이야... 별 하나하나 뒤에 잠든 힘과 신비가, 누가 끌어 쓰기만을 기다리고 있지!
Overture to Despair#374.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#375.src: Well, I suppose it wasn't much of a surprise when that was the shape Her Majesty's blessing took on, once I received it on ascension.
Overture to Despair#375.dst: 뭐, 승천할 때 받은 여왕 폐하의 축복이 그런 형태를 띤 것도 그리 놀랍진 않았지.
Overture to Despair#375.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#376.src: As I said before, it's quite uncommon for me to personally give a tour of the castle. I take the opportunity to speak on my many accomplishments whenever I can!
Overture to Despair#376.dst: 아까 말했듯, 내가 직접 성을 안내하는 건 아주 드문 일이야. 그럴 때마다 내 수많은 업적을 얘기할 기회로 삼지!
Overture to Despair#376.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#377.src: Oh, and you mean to tell me that if you had a voice like mine, you wouldn't do the very same? Ha! Perhaps someday, you'll understand.
Overture to Despair#377.dst: 오, 그럼 너라면 나 같은 목소리를 가졌어도 똑같이 안 하겠다는 건가? 하! 언젠가는 이해하겠지.
Overture to Despair#377.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#378.src: Ah, the Sovereigns' blessings... they truly are an assorted bunch. Each taking on a distinct shape based on the person receiving it.
Overture to Despair#378.dst: 아, 군주들의 축복... 정말 가지각색이지. 받는 사람에 따라 저마다 다른 형태를 띠거든.
Overture to Despair#378.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#379.src: I wonder, what could yours have looked like? Anything would be more interesting than that of your friend's... oh yes, "Intention." How passive, how boring.
Overture to Despair#379.dst: 궁금하군, 네 건 어떤 모습이었을까? 네 친구 것보다는 뭐든 흥미롭겠지... 오 그래, '의도'. 얼마나 수동적이고, 얼마나 지루한지.
Overture to Despair#379.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#380.src: But I suppose it's just as well, given his... shall we say, transience. Quite the mission he's signed himself up for! What a relief that I have no need to concern myself with it.
Overture to Despair#380.dst: 하지만 그의... 뭐랄까, 덧없음을 생각하면 오히려 잘된 일이지. 스스로 꽤나 큰 임무를 떠맡았더군! 내가 신경 쓸 일이 아니라 다행이야.
Overture to Despair#380.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#381.src: ...oh, yes, this here is my hobby tower! I had it constructed - what was it, {~} years ago? - in order to store all my various projects. I'm a man of many interests, you see.
Overture to Despair#381.dst: ...오, 그래, 여긴 내 취미 탑이다! 온갖 프로젝트를 보관하려고 지었지 - 그게, {~}년 전이었나? 보다시피 난 관심사가 많은 사람이라.
Overture to Despair#381.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#382.src: As of late, I've been experimenting with gardening, of all things. Incredibly boring, mind you - a word of advice? Don't bother. It is not worth your time.
Overture to Despair#382.dst: 요즘은 하필이면 원예를 시험해 보고 있지. 정말 지루해 - 조언 하나 해 줄까? 하지 마라. 시간 낭비야.
Overture to Despair#382.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#383.src: Ah... a better view than this is hard to come by. The {p}, in all their glory! Who needs the {p} when you have this!
Overture to Despair#383.dst: 아... 이보다 좋은 전망은 찾기 힘들지. 영광스러운 {p}! 이게 있는데 {p}이(가) 무슨 필요가 있나!
Overture to Despair#383.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#385.src: Sovereign Majin. And {u}. I've been expecting you.

Overture to Despair#386.src: Talk to Sovereign Majin and the Spymaster at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#387.src: It's been a while since we've met face to face, hasn't it? And you've been busy.
Overture to Despair#387.dst: 얼굴을 마주한 지 꽤 되었구나, 그렇지? 그간 바빴더군.

Overture to Despair#388.src: So in the end you made the choice to search for your answers... bold, I'll admit. You've caused quite the disruption thus far.
Overture to Despair#388.dst: 결국 스스로 답을 찾기로 했구나... 대담하다는 건 인정하지. 지금까지 꽤 큰 혼란을 일으켰다.

Overture to Despair#389.src: I am the Second, the Spymaster. You may call me Two.

Overture to Despair#390.src: You've quite the set of accomplishments, it turns out. Careless work by our inquisitors, perhaps, that we did not know beforehand... with some exceptions, granted.
Overture to Despair#390.dst: 네 업적이 상당하더구나. 미리 알지 못한 건 아마 심문관들의 부주의겠지... 물론, 몇몇 예외는 있다만.
Overture to Despair#390.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#391.src: To think, the Shade was struck blind by your hand! At no small cost, of course... but a shattered soul means little in the wider stage.
Overture to Despair#391.dst: 그림자가 네 손에 눈이 멀다니! 물론 대가가 적진 않았다... 허나 부서진 영혼 하나는 더 큰 무대에선 별 의미 없지.
Overture to Despair#391.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#392.src: Had we known, would you have been given greater consideration? Perhaps. Or perhaps not. Each flaw remains as damning as before.
Overture to Despair#392.dst: 알았더라면 너를 더 고려했을까? 아마도. 아니면 아니었겠지. 결점 하나하나는 여전히 치명적이니.
Overture to Despair#392.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#393.src: Oh, get to the point, would you? I have more important things to attend to then this frivolous attempt at information gathering.
Overture to Despair#393.dst: 오, 요점만 말하지 그래? 이런 하찮은 정보 수집보다 더 중요한 일이 있어서 말이야.
Overture to Despair#393.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#395.src: Of all your accomplishments, of all your history, of each point along your storied trail, there is but one we cannot see. A place we cannot go.
Overture to Despair#395.dst: 네 모든 업적, 모든 역사, 네 파란만장한 여정의 모든 지점 중에서, 우리가 볼 수 없는 곳이 딱 하나 있다. 갈 수 없는 곳이.
Overture to Despair#395.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#396.src: You and the Light's Scion entered the Realm of Light. At a time pinpointed to have transpired during your stay within, the spread of Gavel's Decay abruptly ceased.
Overture to Despair#396.dst: 너와 빛의 후예가 빛의 영역에 들어갔지. 네가 그 안에 머문 것으로 추정되는 바로 그때, Gavel 쇠락의 확산이 갑자기 멈췄다.
Overture to Despair#396.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#397.src: You would later return to your numerous adventures, not a sign of ever having traversed the realms at all. She has not been seen since.
Overture to Despair#397.dst: 그 뒤 넌 수많은 모험으로 돌아왔지. 영역을 넘나든 흔적은 하나도 없이. 그녀는 그 후로 한 번도 목격되지 않았다.
Overture to Despair#397.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#398.src: I do not expect you to share this information freely. That is why we are here. To make an... exchange, of sorts.
Overture to Despair#398.dst: 네가 이 정보를 순순히 내놓으리라 기대하진 않는다. 그래서 우리가 여기 있는 거다. 일종의... 거래를 하려고.
Overture to Despair#398.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#399.src: I should rather like to know the same thing myself! The way I see it, it hardly impacts the wider scope of your schemes.
Overture to Despair#399.dst: 나도 그게 몹시 궁금하군! 내가 보기엔 네 계략의 큰 그림엔 거의 영향도 없을 텐데.
Overture to Despair#399.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#400.src: I do like to be meticulous. Each additional defined variable helps with the accuracy of my predictions.
Overture to Despair#400.dst: 난 꼼꼼한 걸 좋아한다. 정의된 변수가 하나 늘 때마다 내 예측이 더 정확해지지.
Overture to Despair#400.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#401.src: Regardless - the request comes directly from Her Majesty. It appears she is just as interested in the answer as I am.
Overture to Despair#401.dst: 어쨌든 - 이 요청은 여왕 폐하께서 직접 하신 것이다. 폐하께서도 나만큼 그 답을 궁금해하시는 모양이다.
Overture to Despair#401.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#402.src: My goodness, what a question! How does the Spymaster know these things? What a conundrum - perhaps the title should clue you in?
Overture to Despair#402.dst: 맙소사, 대단한 질문이군! 첩보대장이 이런 걸 어떻게 아느냐고? 참 난제로다 - 직함을 보면 감이 오지 않나?
Overture to Despair#402.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#403.src: There is little I do not keep track of in this world. Mostly, my inquisitors work to collect information beyond our gates...
Overture to Despair#403.dst: 이 세상에 내가 파악하지 않는 일은 거의 없다. 대개는 심문관들이 우리 성문 밖에서 정보를 모으지...
Overture to Despair#403.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#404.src: Though, in special circumstances, I have been known to do so myself. Such as the one we find ourselves in now.
Overture to Despair#404.dst: 하지만 특별한 경우엔 내가 직접 나서기도 한다. 지금 우리가 처한 이런 경우처럼.
Overture to Despair#404.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#405.src: Entry to their Claims is not such an easy task if uninvited. You've seen the portal that lies at the end of the Expanse, haven't you? Still active, yet... sealed shut.
Overture to Despair#405.dst: 초대받지 않았다면 그들의 영역에 들어가긴 쉽지 않다. Expanse 끝에 있는 차원문을 봤겠지? 여전히 작동하지만... 굳게 봉인되어 있다.
Overture to Despair#405.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#406.src: It seems the Shade did not take well to losing its Sight. An act of caution, blocking your access to its domain. The Light is much the same.
Overture to Despair#406.dst: 그림자는 시야를 잃은 걸 달가워하지 않은 모양이다. 네가 영역에 들어오지 못하게 막은 건 경계의 표시지. 빛도 마찬가지다.
Overture to Despair#406.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#407.src: Awestruck, are we? I do suppose such is the natural consequence of being in the vicinity of the crown's two strongest Sovereigns!
Overture to Despair#407.dst: 넋이 나갔나? 왕실에서 가장 강한 두 군주 곁에 있으니 당연한 반응이겠지!
Overture to Despair#407.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#408.src: But I'm afraid we do need you to speak up, so do get over yourself, would you?
Overture to Despair#408.dst: 하지만 유감스럽게도 네가 입을 열어야 해. 그러니 정신 좀 차리지 그래?
Overture to Despair#408.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#409.src: And so, we return to the exchange. If you tell us what we wish to know, I will offer some valuable information in return. I trust it will be of interest to you.
Overture to Despair#409.dst: 그럼, 거래 얘기로 돌아가지. 우리가 알고 싶은 걸 말해 주면, 대가로 값진 정보를 주겠다. 네게 흥미로울 거라 믿는다.
Overture to Despair#409.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#410.src: Well, do we have a deal?
Overture to Despair#410.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#411.src: You always have a choice. But sometimes, there is a right and a wrong choice to make. The decision is yours.
Overture to Despair#411.dst: 선택은 언제나 있다. 하지만 때로는 옳은 선택과 그른 선택이 있지. 결정은 네 몫이다.
Overture to Despair#411.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#412.src: So tell me. What happened in the Realm of Light? What could we not see?
Overture to Despair#412.dst: 그럼 말해 보아라. 빛의 영역에서 무슨 일이 있었지? 우리가 무엇을 보지 못했나?
Overture to Despair#412.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#414.src: How very interesting. To think, the Shade has enough trust in War's lost Scion to send him to defend its trump card...
Overture to Despair#414.dst: 참으로 흥미롭구나. 그림자가 전쟁의 잃어버린 후예를 그만큼 믿어서 비장의 패를 지키러 보내다니...
Overture to Despair#414.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#415.src: I had wondered when he might finally show his ugly face again. Heavens know we'd had enough of him already.
Overture to Despair#415.dst: 그 추한 낯짝을 언제 다시 드러내나 궁금했지. 그 녀석이라면 이미 질릴 만큼 질렸는데.
Overture to Despair#415.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#416.src: And the Dawn is freed from the Dusk's assault... but its Scion is lost to the Dark's Claim... a step forward, and a step back alike.
Overture to Despair#416.dst: 그리고 새벽은 황혼의 공세에서 풀려났지만... 그 후예는 어둠의 영토에서 사라졌다... 한 걸음 전진이자, 한 걸음 후퇴로구나.
Overture to Despair#416.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#417.src: A step back, perhaps, but it could also be a boon in disguise. She could serve as a potential ally for your... whatever, if you could only locate her.
Overture to Despair#417.dst: 후퇴일지도 모르지만, 전화위복일 수도 있지. 찾아내기만 하면 그녀가 네... 뭐든 간에, 그 일의 잠재적 동맹이 될 수 있어.
Overture to Despair#417.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#418.src: Certainly, she could. This will shift the trajectory of certain shards of possibility... I'll have to dive deeper into the consequences.
Overture to Despair#418.dst: 분명 그럴 수 있지. 이것으로 몇몇 가능성 파편의 궤적이 바뀌겠구나... 그 결과를 더 깊이 살펴봐야겠다.
Overture to Despair#418.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#419.src: Regardless, this has been enlightening. Her Majesty will certainly be interested in these developments.
Overture to Despair#419.dst: 어쨌든, 많은 걸 깨우쳐 주었다. 여왕 폐하께서도 이 전개에 분명 관심을 가지실 것이다.
Overture to Despair#419.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#420.src: You refer to the War of the Realms, I presume?
Overture to Despair#420.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#421.src: I suppose it must. Beyond the wider scope, why do we care? Wynn's corruption is at a safe distance, and both Light and Dark are far, far away.
Overture to Despair#421.dst: 그래야겠지. 큰 그림은 제쳐 두고, 우리가 왜 신경 써야 하지? Wynn의 타락은 충분히 멀고, 빛과 어둠은 아주, 아주 멀리 있다.
Overture to Despair#421.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#422.src: I can answer your question. But first, a tale.
Overture to Despair#422.dst: 네 질문에 답해 줄 수 있다. 하지만 먼저, 이야기 하나를 들려주지.
Overture to Despair#422.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#423.src: Once, there were two twins orbiting one another, each laying claim to their own piece of the void they were given.
Overture to Despair#423.dst: 옛날에, 서로의 주위를 도는 쌍둥이가 있었다. 둘은 저마다 주어진 공허의 한 조각을 차지했지.
Overture to Despair#423.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#424.src: The first was bright, radiant, overwhelming. The other was dark, shadowed, suffocating. Gazing through the abyss, they saw one another - each a mirror image of the other.
Overture to Despair#424.dst: 첫째는 밝고, 찬란하고, 압도적이었다. 다른 하나는 어둡고, 음울하고, 숨 막혔지. 심연 너머로 서로를 바라보니 - 서로가 서로의 거울상이었다.
Overture to Despair#424.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#425.src: The twins grew to hate each other. They built forms all their own, denying the truth of their reflections. They tried, and tried, and tried to break their bonds...
Overture to Despair#425.dst: 쌍둥이는 서로를 증오하게 되었다. 각자 자신만의 형체를 빚어 거울 속 진실을 부정했지. 둘은 묶인 끈을 끊으려 하고, 또 하고, 또 했다...
Overture to Despair#425.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#426.src: ...but in the end, they could do naught but orbit - holding influence in their own right, but possessing nothing to exert it on.
Overture to Despair#426.dst: ...하지만 결국 둘은 그저 돌기만 할 뿐이었다 - 저마다 힘은 쥐었으되, 그 힘을 떨칠 대상이 없었지.
Overture to Despair#426.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#427.src: Until... they found it. A miraculous world, of magic and life, and all of a sudden, nothing became something.
Overture to Despair#427.dst: 그러다... 그것을 발견했다. 마법과 생명이 가득한 기적 같은 세계를. 그리고 순식간에, 무(無)가 유(有)가 되었다.
Overture to Despair#427.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#429.src: And in so doing, they came to shatter the mirror which once held their reflections. A building pressure of light and dark and hate, until finally enough was enough...
Overture to Despair#429.dst: 그러는 사이, 한때 둘의 모습을 비추던 거울을 깨뜨리고 말았다. 빛과 어둠과 증오의 압력이 쌓이고 쌓여, 마침내 한계에 이르렀지...
Overture to Despair#429.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#430.src: And from those uncountable shattered pieces of their battleground, War came to be.
Overture to Despair#430.dst: 그리고 그 전장의 셀 수 없는 파편들 속에서, 전쟁이 태어났다.
Overture to Despair#430.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#431.src: War, Chaos, Hate... call it what you will. It was lesser, holding less control over itself than the twins from which it was birthed.
Overture to Despair#431.dst: 전쟁, 혼돈, 증오... 뭐라 부르든 상관없다. 그것은 열등했다. 자신을 낳은 쌍둥이보다 스스로를 다스리는 힘이 약했지.
Overture to Despair#431.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#432.src: All it knew was the hatred of the twins, directed towards one another, never acknowledging the battlefield they had made. All it knew was the pain of being.
Overture to Despair#432.dst: 그것이 아는 건 서로를 향한 쌍둥이의 증오뿐이었다. 그들이 만든 전장은 한 번도 돌아보지 않았지. 그것이 아는 건 존재의 고통뿐이었다.
Overture to Despair#432.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#433.src: Until, one day... it all stopped. The twins had lost their connection to their world of influence, and could no longer sustain their endless War.
Overture to Despair#433.dst: 그러던 어느 날... 모든 게 멈췄다. 쌍둥이가 힘을 뻗던 세계와의 연결을 잃고, 끝없는 전쟁을 더는 이어 갈 수 없게 된 거지.
Overture to Despair#433.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#434.src: It was in that silence that War could finally sense beyond itself, could feel the world the twins had taken for granted, the beauty they had discarded in their race for victory.
Overture to Despair#434.dst: 그 고요 속에서 비로소 전쟁은 자신 너머를 감지했다. 쌍둥이가 당연하게 여긴 세계를, 승리를 다투느라 버린 아름다움을 느낄 수 있었지.
Overture to Despair#434.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#435.src: And so, when the connections emerged once more, it took its chance.
Overture to Despair#435.dst: 그래서, 연결이 다시 나타났을 때, 그것은 기회를 잡았다.
Overture to Despair#435.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#436.src: It broke through the endless void, forcing its own connection unto the world, following in the twins' example.
Overture to Despair#436.dst: 그것은 끝없는 공허를 뚫고, 쌍둥이를 본받아, 세계에 자신의 연결을 억지로 이었다.
Overture to Despair#436.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#437.src: Finally, it saw the world beyond... sprawling plains, forests, seas. Saw towns, cities, farmlands- war, destruction, tainted by the human desperation to live.
Overture to Despair#437.dst: 마침내 그것은 바깥 세계를 보았다... 펼쳐진 평원, 숲, 바다. 마을, 도시, 농지를 보았다- 살고자 발버둥 치는 인간의 절박함에 물든 전쟁과 파괴를.
Overture to Despair#437.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#438.src: And it began to dream of that desperation itself.
Overture to Despair#438.dst: 그리고 그것은 그 절박함 자체를 꿈꾸기 시작했다.
Overture to Despair#438.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#440.src: Her Majesty is War - was War. But it is no longer hers - instead, she has chosen to lay claim to this world's protection.
Overture to Despair#440.dst: 여왕 폐하께서 전쟁이시다 - 전쟁이셨다. 하지만 더는 폐하의 것이 아니지 - 대신 폐하는 이 세계의 수호를 택하셨다.
Overture to Despair#440.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#441.src: And in the meanwhile, the twins continue to take and take and take. If left unchecked, they will take until there is nothing left to fight over.
Overture to Despair#441.dst: 그러는 동안에도 쌍둥이는 빼앗고, 빼앗고, 또 빼앗는다. 내버려 두면, 다툴 것이 하나도 남지 않을 때까지 빼앗겠지.
Overture to Despair#441.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#442.src: ... Will that do for your answer?
Overture to Despair#442.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#443.src: You've a streak for the dramatic, don't you... Was that truly all necessary? We could have always laid it out simply- on that note, why even answer at all?
Overture to Despair#443.dst: 극적인 걸 참 좋아하는군... 정말 그게 다 필요했나? 간단히 설명할 수도 있었는데- 그러고 보니, 대체 왜 답해 준 거지?
Overture to Despair#443.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#444.src: I believe the context to be important.
Overture to Despair#444.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#445.src: Of course you would... well then, are we finished here?
Overture to Despair#445.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#446.src: I suppose we are. We may consider this interrogation adjourned.
Overture to Despair#446.dst: 그런 것 같군. 이 심문은 이것으로 휴회하지.
