Overture to Despair#446.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#447.src: Ah ah ah! Not so fast. Certainly, neither of us will deign to stop your escape... but the troops lying in wait will have no such reservations.
Overture to Despair#447.dst: 아, 아, 아! 그렇게 서두르지 마라. 물론 우리 둘 다 네 도주를 막는 수고는 안 하겠지만... 매복한 병력은 그런 망설임이 없을 거다.
Overture to Despair#447.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#448.src: Now, see yourself out, would you? You are dismissed.
Overture to Despair#448.dst: 자, 알아서 나가 주겠나? 물러가도 좋다.
Overture to Despair#448.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#450.src: ...oh, would you take your leave already? You're ruining the view.
Overture to Despair#450.dst: ...오, 이제 좀 가 주겠나? 경치를 망치고 있잖아.
Overture to Despair#450.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#451.src: I believe we'll meet once again very soon.
Overture to Despair#451.speaker: Sovereign Two

Overture to Despair#452.src: Regroup at the Crown Jewel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#454.dst: 너- 넌 무, 무사하구나. 다, 다행이다...
Overture to Despair#454.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#456.src: We're alive, so... better than nothing, huh?
Overture to Despair#456.dst: 우린 살아 있으니... 없는 것보단 낫지, 응?
Overture to Despair#456.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#460.src: ...yeah. Gods, I... I can't believe they're gone.
Overture to Despair#460.dst: ...그래. 세상에, 난... 그 둘이 갔다는 게 안 믿겨.
Overture to Despair#460.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#461.src: S...Syndra, a- and Mora... and we, we c...couldn't do an- any- anything!
Overture to Despair#461.dst: S...Syndra, 그- 그리고 Mora... 그런데 우, 우린 아무- 아무것도 못 했어!
Overture to Despair#461.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#462.src: Ugh, how stupid could we have been...? Of course they knew what we were planning. A group that big...
Overture to Despair#462.dst: 으, 우린 얼마나 멍청했던 거야...? 당연히 우리 계획을 알고 있었겠지. 그렇게 큰 무리였는데...
Overture to Despair#462.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#463.src: What was Syndra thinking? We should've called it off the minute we knew there would be another Sovereign...
Overture to Despair#463.dst: Syndra는 무슨 생각이었을까? 군주가 하나 더 온다는 걸 안 순간 그만뒀어야 했는데...
Overture to Despair#463.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#464.src: What was so important to her that she'd risk all of our lives like that...?
Overture to Despair#464.dst: 대체 뭐가 그렇게 중요해서 우리 모두의 목숨을 그렇게 걸었던 거야...?
Overture to Despair#464.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#465.src: I don't... care. It- it doesn't matter now. She's... dead. We don't need to talk about this.
Overture to Despair#465.dst: 난... 상관없어. 그- 그건 이제 중요하지 않아. 그녀는... 죽었어. 이 얘긴 할 필요 없어.
Overture to Despair#465.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#466.src: ...S...Sui, h...how are you ho- holding up? It c- couldn't have b...been easy, on y- your own-
Overture to Despair#466.dst: ...S...Sui, 너, 넌 괜- 괜찮아? 호, 혼자서 쉬, 쉽지 않았을 텐- 텐데-
Overture to Despair#466.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#467.src: I'm fine, Zeph. We've got you two back now, so... so everything's alright. It is.
Overture to Despair#467.dst: 난 괜찮아, Zeph. 이제 너희 둘을 되찾았으니까... 그러니까 다 괜찮아. 정말이야.
Overture to Despair#467.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#468.src: Are you sure? I don't think I've ever seen you this wound up before.
Overture to Despair#468.dst: 확실해? 네가 이렇게 날이 선 건 처음 보는 것 같은데.
Overture to Despair#468.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#469.src: Stop. Stop that. I'm fine, I am, everyone's safe who- who can be, so... so that's it. We can, um, start planning ahead!!!
Overture to Despair#469.dst: 그만. 그만해. 난 괜찮아, 진짜야, 무사할 수- 있는 사람은 다 무사해, 그러니까... 그걸로 된 거야. 우리, 음, 앞으로 계획을 세우면 돼!!!
Overture to Despair#469.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#471.src: ...please stop looking at me like that.
Overture to Despair#471.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#472.src: ...fine. When Zeph and I were caught at the festival, we were split up from the others.
Overture to Despair#472.dst: ...알았어. 축제에서 Zeph랑 내가 잡혔을 때, 우린 다른 사람들이랑 떨어졌어.
Overture to Despair#472.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#473.src: I- I o...overheard them t- talking about... a- about D...Deraj Prison.
Overture to Despair#473.dst: 나- 난 그놈들이... D...Deraj 감옥 얘, 얘기하는 걸 어, 엿들었어.
Overture to Despair#473.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#474.src: We, um, heard the same. Yusanu... he- might be working on it. I don't know for sure. We... parted ways in the {p}.
Overture to Despair#474.dst: 우리도, 음, 같은 걸 들었어. Yusanu가... 그- 그 일을 하고 있을지도 몰라. 확실하진 않아. 우린... {p}에서 헤어졌어.
Overture to Despair#474.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#476.src: With the Canopy. They're... safe is maybe the wrong word. But, um, he's protected. So... I think he can do it.
Overture to Despair#476.dst: Canopy랑 같이 있어. 걔들은... 무사하다는 말은 좀 아닐 수도 있지만. 음, 보호는 받고 있어. 그러니까... 해낼 거야.
Overture to Despair#476.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#477.src: ...s- so you th...think they'll be al- alright...?
Overture to Despair#477.dst: ...그, 그럼 넌 다들 괘, 괜찮을 거라고 새, 생각해...?
Overture to Despair#477.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#478.src: We don't really have a choice but to trust that they will, since... we're up here, and they're not.
Overture to Despair#478.dst: 믿는 수밖에 없지, 왜냐면... 우린 여기 위에 있고, 걔들은 아니니까.
Overture to Despair#478.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#479.src: So. So, so, so. I've had a lot of time to think while imprisoned. About the past, the present, the future, all of it.
Overture to Despair#479.dst: 그래서. 그래, 그래, 그래. 갇혀 있는 동안 생각할 시간이 많았어. 과거, 현재, 미래, 전부 다.
Overture to Despair#479.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#480.src: I've come up with lots and lots of possible plans to take down the crown! To, uh, limited success...
Overture to Despair#480.dst: 왕실을 무너뜨릴 계획을 엄청 많이 세웠다고! 어, 성과는 별로였지만...
Overture to Despair#480.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#481.src: Lots of pitfalls. There's so many ways things can go wrong. So, so many...
Overture to Despair#481.dst: 함정이 많아. 일이 틀어질 수 있는 방법이 너무 많아. 너무, 너무 많아...
Overture to Despair#481.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#482.src: ...I think I'll need to sort through them again, with... with our new information. And... and our losses.
Overture to Despair#482.dst: ...다시 정리해야 할 것 같아. 새... 새로운 정보까지 넣어서. 그리고... 우리가 잃은 것도.
Overture to Despair#482.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#484.src: I- I'm going to, um, go out for... for a little. I, ha, I need some air, I think.
Overture to Despair#484.dst: 나- 난, 음, 잠깐... 잠깐 나갔다 올게. 나, 하, 바람 좀 쐬어야겠어.
Overture to Despair#484.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#487.src: She's definitely not taking Mora's loss well, that's for sure... {u}, how long has she been like this?
Overture to Despair#487.dst: 확실히 Mora를 잃은 걸 잘 못 받아들이고 있어... {u}, 쟤 이런 지 얼마나 됐어?
Overture to Despair#487.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#488.src: SHE k...killed a S- Sovereign?! She d...didn't tell us that...
Overture to Despair#488.dst: 쟤가 군, 군주를 주, 죽였다고?! 우리한텐 마, 말 안 했는데...
Overture to Despair#488.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#489.src: ...does it have to do with the ice? She's been... kind of cagey about it.
Overture to Despair#489.dst: ...그 얼음이랑 관련 있어? 그거에 대해선... 좀 말을 아끼더라.
Overture to Despair#489.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#490.src: H...her magic used t- to be so... s...so beautiful, so s- serene...
Overture to Despair#490.dst: 쟤, 쟤 마법은 예전엔 저, 정말... 아, 아름답고, 고, 고요했는데...
Overture to Despair#490.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#491.src: A- and- and n...now it looks... d- dangerous. Lethal.
Overture to Despair#491.dst: 그- 그런데- 이, 이젠... 위, 위험해 보여. 치명적이야.
Overture to Despair#491.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#492.src: The p...poet in me can't h- help but see it as a r...reflection of her n- new- newfound coldness...
Overture to Despair#492.dst: 내 안의 시, 시인은 그게 쟤의 새- 새로 생긴 냉기를 비, 비추는 것처럼만 보여...
Overture to Despair#492.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#493.src: Sorry, say that again? The poet in you? What poet?!
Overture to Despair#493.dst: 미안, 다시 말해 볼래? 네 안의 시인? 무슨 시인?!
Overture to Despair#493.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#494.src: I've ch...changed, Rex... th- there's a, pfft, a- a d...darkness inside me now...
Overture to Despair#494.dst: 나도 벼, 변했어, Rex... 이- 이제 내 안엔, 풉, 어- 어, 어둠이 있어...
Overture to Despair#494.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#495.src: Oh, het over yourself! I was there too, idiot!
Overture to Despair#495.dst: 아, 좀 작작 해! 나도 거기 있었거든, 바보야!
Overture to Despair#495.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#496.src: ...oh, {u}, before I forget. When we got here, there was an envelope left for you on your bed.
Overture to Despair#496.dst: ...아, {u}, 잊기 전에. 우리가 왔을 때 네 침대 위에 봉투가 하나 놓여 있었어.
Overture to Despair#496.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#497.src: I haven't read it, but... be careful, okay?
Overture to Despair#497.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#498.src: We c...can talk to Sui wh- when she gets back.
Overture to Despair#498.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#499.src: Head to the location mentioned in the letter at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#500.src: I- I- I st...still can't believe you're r...real. That we're... fr...free.
Overture to Despair#500.dst: 나- 나- 난 아, 아직도 네가 지, 진짜라는 게 안 믿겨. 우리가... 자, 자유라는 게.
Overture to Despair#500.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#503.src: I... I th- think so. It was b...bad, but it- it's o...over now.
Overture to Despair#503.dst: 나... 나 그, 그런 것 같아. 끔, 끔찍했지만- 이, 이제 끝났어.
Overture to Despair#503.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#504.src: Seeing S...Sui back there was... i- in- incredible. It was like a m...miracle. It st...still feels... surreal.
Overture to Despair#504.dst: 거기서 S...Sui를 봤을 때... 미- 믿기지 않았어. 기, 기적 같았어. 아, 아직도... 꿈만 같아.
Overture to Despair#504.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#506.src: It's the w...worst thing I've ev- ever been th...through.
Overture to Despair#506.dst: 내가 겪, 겪어 본 일 중에 최, 최악이었어.
Overture to Despair#506.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#507.src: I- I- I d...don't want to, t...talk about it. I w- want to f- for- forget all the- th- the little details, and- A- AND-
Overture to Despair#507.dst: 나- 나- 난 그, 그 얘긴, 하, 하기 싫어. 자- 자잘한 거 저, 전부 잊고 싶어, 그리고- 그- 그리고-
Overture to Despair#507.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#509.src: I'm glad Gikyo's d...dead. They d- des- deserved it, a- and... worse.
Overture to Despair#509.dst: Gikyo가 주, 죽어서 다행이야. 그, 그럴 만했어, 아- 아니... 더한 걸 당해도.
Overture to Despair#509.speaker: Zeph

Overture to Despair#511.src: Sigh... I can't wait to sleep in a nice bed again.
Overture to Despair#511.dst: 하아... 좋은 침대에서 빨리 다시 자고 싶다.
Overture to Despair#511.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#513.src: What's with the stupid questions? No, dumbass, of course not.
Overture to Despair#513.dst: 뭔 멍청한 질문이야? 아니, 바보야, 당연히 아니지.
Overture to Despair#513.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#514.src: Being kept in a cage, it... it reminded me too much of living back home.
Overture to Despair#514.dst: 우리에 갇혀 있으니까... 집에서 살던 때가 너무 생각나더라.
Overture to Despair#514.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#515.src: And... now we're here! So. You know.
Overture to Despair#515.dst: 근데... 이젠 여기 있잖아! 뭐. 알지?
Overture to Despair#515.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#516.src: Oh, boy. If I'm being honest... time sort of blended together.
Overture to Despair#516.dst: 아이고. 솔직히 말하면... 시간이 뒤죽박죽 섞였어.
Overture to Despair#516.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#517.src: They took my bow from me almost immediately. I... I couldn't focus on anything. It was like I was barely even there. I just... dreamt.
Overture to Despair#517.dst: 거의 바로 활을 뺏겼어. 난... 아무것도 집중할 수가 없었어. 거기 있는 것 같지도 않았지. 그냥... 꿈을 꿨어.
Overture to Despair#517.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#518.src: I dreamed of Auburn, of my brother, of my new family, of the people I've lost, of... of my bow.
Overture to Despair#518.dst: Auburn 꿈, 형 꿈, 새 가족 꿈, 잃어버린 사람들 꿈... 그리고... 내 활 꿈.
Overture to Despair#518.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#519.src: I got used to it, eventually. Like losing a limb! It didn't stop feeling like a loss, but... I figured out how to live without my bow by my side.
Overture to Despair#519.dst: 결국 익숙해졌어. 팔다리 하나 잃은 것처럼! 상실감이 사라지진 않았지만... 활 없이 사는 법을 알게 됐지.
Overture to Despair#519.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#520.src: I think... I think I was the lucky one. I was never really present, so everything they did to us, it... it feels like a hazy memory of a dream.
Overture to Despair#520.dst: 내 생각엔... 난 운이 좋은 쪽이었어. 제정신이 아니었으니까, 놈들이 우리한테 한 일이 전부... 흐릿한 꿈의 기억 같아.
Overture to Despair#520.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#521.src: Zeph... he, uh, couldn't distance himself. But I won't speak for him. Ask him yourself, if you really want to.
Overture to Despair#521.dst: Zeph는... 어, 그렇게 거리를 둘 수가 없었어. 그래도 대신 말하진 않을게. 정말 궁금하면 직접 물어봐.
Overture to Despair#521.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#522.src: Ugh. You met those idiots? They're just a glorified book club, honestly.
Overture to Despair#522.dst: 으. 그 멍청이들 만났어? 솔직히 그냥 거창한 독서 모임이야.
Overture to Despair#522.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#523.src: Sure, they're not all bad, but for the most part... they're performative.
Overture to Despair#523.dst: 뭐, 다 나쁜 건 아닌데, 대부분은... 보여 주기식이야.
Overture to Despair#523.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#524.src: I only heard about them through my brother, and he was always complaining. But I guess they were the only people he could find who agreed with him, so...
Overture to Despair#524.dst: 형한테 들어서 알게 됐는데, 형은 맨날 불평했어. 그래도 형이랑 생각이 맞는 사람은 걔들뿐이었나 봐, 그러니까...
Overture to Despair#524.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#526.src: Whatever. I'm glad you managed to get something out of them, at least.
Overture to Despair#526.dst: 됐어. 그래도 거기서 뭐라도 건졌다니 다행이다.
Overture to Despair#526.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#527.src: They're all over the place! In some of them, we all storm the gates of the citadel and break through their defenses...
Overture to Despair#527.dst: 완전 제각각이야! 어떤 건 우리 다 같이 성채 문을 급습해서 방어선을 뚫고...
Overture to Despair#527.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#528.src: ...in others, I get to put an arrow through the eyes of each and every Sovereign myself.
Overture to Despair#528.dst: ...어떤 건 내가 직접 군주 한 놈 한 놈 눈에 화살을 꽂아 주고.
Overture to Despair#528.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#529.src: They're... mostly unusable. I just needed to do something with my head. I think there's probably something I can salvage, but for the most part...
Overture to Despair#529.dst: 거의... 쓸모없어. 그냥 머리를 굴릴 거리가 필요했어. 건질 만한 게 있을 것 같긴 한데, 대부분은...
Overture to Despair#529.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#530.src: Eh. We've got time. Still another week until the festival, after all...
Overture to Despair#530.dst: 에이. 시간 있어. 어쨌든 축제까진 아직 일주일 남았으니까...
Overture to Despair#530.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#531.src: Good luck. Come back to us alive, alright? We only just all reunited, it'd suck having to go save you instantly.
Overture to Despair#531.dst: 행운을 빌어. 살아서 돌아와, 알았지? 이제 막 다시 모였는데, 곧바로 널 구하러 가야 하면 최악이잖아.
Overture to Despair#531.speaker: Rex

Overture to Despair#534.src: ...you should know. She told me. That mission. That damned mission, the one I-
Overture to Despair#534.dst: ...알 텐데. 그녀가 말해 줬어. 그 임무. 그 빌어먹을 임무, 내가-
Overture to Despair#534.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#535.src: So I'll ask you again. Is. It. True?
Overture to Despair#535.dst: 그러니까 다시 물을게. 그게. 사실. 이야?
Overture to Despair#535.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#536.src: And you didn't SAY ANYTHING?! Not a word.
Overture to Despair#536.dst: 그런데 아무 말도 '안 했다고'?! 한 마디도.
Overture to Despair#536.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#537.src: All this time, I've been wondering how he's doing, where he is- while you... you... you knew. And you chose to stay silent.
Overture to Despair#537.dst: 그동안 난 그가 어떻게 지내는지, 어디 있는지 궁금해했는데- 넌... 넌... 넌 알고 있었어. 그리고 침묵을 택했지.
Overture to Despair#537.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#538.src: The right time. Of course. Of course! You just needed to find the right time to tell me you KILLED HIM!!!
Overture to Despair#538.dst: 적절한 때. 그렇겠지. 그렇겠지! 네가 그를 '죽였다고' 말할 적절한 때를 찾기만 하면 됐던 거지!!!
Overture to Despair#538.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#539.src: So, now what?! Your "right time" has come and gone, and now we're here.
Overture to Despair#539.dst: 그래서, 이제 어쩔 건데?! 네 '적절한 때'는 왔다가 갔고, 우린 지금 여기 있어.
Overture to Despair#539.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#540.src: I don't care what it was, {u}!! I don't care what you saw happen, or why you think it had to happen, I care that he's gone!!!
Overture to Despair#540.dst: 무슨 사정이었든 상관없어, {u}!! 네가 뭘 봤는지도, 왜 그래야만 했다고 생각하는지도 상관없어, 그가 없다는 게 중요해!!!
Overture to Despair#540.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#541.src: I don't have much, you know? A couple of acquaintances in Gavel, maybe. No one to really keep up with!
Overture to Despair#541.dst: 나한텐 가진 게 별로 없어, 알아? Gavel에 아는 사람 몇 명 정도. 진짜로 연락하고 지낼 사람은 없어!
Overture to Despair#541.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#542.src: But I had him. And you TOOK HIM from me!!!!
Overture to Despair#542.dst: 하지만 나한텐 그가 있었어. 그런데 네가 그를 '빼앗아 갔어'!!!!
Overture to Despair#542.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#543.src: He was all I had left, and you took him from me...
Overture to Despair#543.dst: 그가 내게 남은 전부였는데, 네가 빼앗아 갔어...
Overture to Despair#543.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#544.src: Why you? Why did it have to be you? If only the roles had been reversed- If only he were here instead of YOU!!!
Overture to Despair#544.dst: 왜 너야? 왜 하필 너여야 했어? 역할이 반대였다면- 너 대신 그가 여기 있었다면!!!
Overture to Despair#544.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#545.src: He would have understood. He would have. He always did. He wouldn't have been so... so... STUBBORNLY, OVERWHELMINGLY, WRONG!!!
Overture to Despair#545.dst: 그라면 이해했을 거야. 그랬을 거야. 늘 그랬으니까. 이렇게까지... 이렇게까지... 고집스럽고, 지독하게, 틀리진 않았을 거야!!!
Overture to Despair#545.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#547.src: ...of course. Of course I am. What are you trying to suggest?
Overture to Despair#547.dst: ...당연하지. 당연히 그래. 무슨 말을 하고 싶은 거야?
Overture to Despair#547.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#548.src: Don't you dare say that to my face. I didn't know him?! When you're the one who- who-
Overture to Despair#548.dst: 감히 내 앞에서 그런 말을 해. 내가 그를 몰랐다고?! 정작 네가- 네가-
Overture to Despair#548.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#549.src: You're right!! You're right, he isn't - and WHOSE fault is that?!
Overture to Despair#549.dst: 네 말이 맞아!! 맞다고, 그는 아니지 - 그럼 그게 '누구' 잘못인데?!
Overture to Despair#549.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#550.src: It's not the crown's, no matter what you want to pin on them. It certainly isn't mine. So who does that leave?! WHO?!
Overture to Despair#550.dst: 왕실 탓은 아니야, 네가 아무리 걔들한테 뒤집어씌우고 싶어도. 내 탓은 더더욱 아니고. 그럼 누가 남지?! 누구?!
Overture to Despair#550.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#552.src: Of course you have nothing to say. You always were a coward.
Overture to Despair#552.dst: 당연히 할 말이 없겠지. 넌 언제나 겁쟁이였으니까.
Overture to Despair#552.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#553.src: We're done here. Whatever... whatever we had- friendship, acquaintances- it doesn't matter. It's through. Get out of my sight.
Overture to Despair#553.dst: 여기까지야. 우리가 뭘 가졌든... 우정이든, 친분이든- 상관없어. 끝났어. 내 눈앞에서 사라져.
Overture to Despair#553.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#554.src: ...before I change my mind and throw you off this dam myself.
Overture to Despair#554.dst: ...마음 바뀌어서 이 댐에서 직접 던져 버리기 전에.
Overture to Despair#554.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#555.src: Goodbye, {u}. I hope you find your new friendships just as fulfilling as you found ours.
Overture to Despair#555.dst: 잘 가, {u}. 새 친구들이 우리만큼 보람차길 바랄게.
Overture to Despair#555.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#559.src: She told me about Aledar. Missing some details, but...
Overture to Despair#559.dst: 그녀가 Aledar 얘기를 해 줬어. 빠진 부분도 있었지만...
Overture to Despair#559.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#560.src: ...I don't know why she'd do it, if not to try and turn me against you.
Overture to Despair#560.dst: ...나랑 너를 갈라놓으려는 게 아니면 왜 그랬는지 모르겠어.
Overture to Despair#560.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#561.src: ...pfft, hah did it yeah, {u}, it worked. We're now bitter enemies, till the day we die.
Overture to Despair#561.dst: ...풉, 하- 성공했어, 그래, {u}, 먹혔어. 우린 이제 죽는 날까지 철천지원수야.
Overture to Despair#561.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#562.src: You put a blade through my through his chest, and I can never forgive you! I will now... dedicate the rest of my life to avenging him!
Overture to Despair#562.dst: 네가 내- 그의 가슴에 칼을 꽂았으니, 절대 용서 못 해! 난 이제... 남은 평생을 그의 복수에 바치겠어!
Overture to Despair#562.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#565.src: No, I... it wasn't your fault. Or... no more your fault than his.
Overture to Despair#565.dst: 아니, 난... 네 잘못이 아니었어. 아니면... 그의 잘못보다 더하진 않았어.
Overture to Despair#565.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#567.src: ...of course, I... I already knew. So, it... wasn't a surprise.
Overture to Despair#567.dst: ...물론, 난... 이미 알고 있었어. 그러니까... 놀랍진 않았어.
Overture to Despair#567.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#568.src: I... it wasn't your fault. Or... no more your fault than his.
Overture to Despair#568.dst: 난... 네 잘못이 아니었어. 아니면... 그의 잘못보다 더하진 않았어.
Overture to Despair#568.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#569.src: It just stings. That he's... he's... he's really gone. That I'll never hear his voice, see his smile, feel his warmth... that for the rest of time, he'll... only ever be a memory.
Overture to Despair#569.dst: 그냥 아파. 그가... 그가... 정말 떠났다는 게. 다시는 목소리도 못 듣고, 웃는 얼굴도 못 보고, 온기도 못 느끼고... 영원히, 그는... 기억으로만 남겠지.
Overture to Despair#569.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#570.src: He's gone, and... he isn't ever coming back. He was the best thing that had ever happened to me, and...
Overture to Despair#570.dst: 그는 떠났고... 다시는 돌아오지 않아. 내 인생에서 가장 좋은 일이었는데...
Overture to Despair#570.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#572.src: I'm... glad you're here, at least. I'm glad to have someone I know.
Overture to Despair#572.dst: 그래도... 네가 와 줘서 다행이야. 아는 사람이 있어서 다행이야.
Overture to Despair#572.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#574.src: I really... can't stop thinking about it. If only he could have been here with us. What would he have done? Which side would he have taken?
Overture to Despair#574.dst: 정말... 생각을 멈출 수가 없어. 그가 우리랑 같이 있었다면. 그라면 어떻게 했을까? 어느 편에 섰을까?
Overture to Despair#574.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#577.src: I guess it doesn't matter, does it? He isn't here. And... he never will be.
Overture to Despair#577.dst: 상관없겠지, 그렇지? 그는 여기 없어. 그리고... 앞으로도 없을 거야.
Overture to Despair#577.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#579.src: We're nearing a final confrontation, you know. Your side's taking action... and so is ours. Next we meet, we'll be enemies.
Overture to Despair#579.dst: 최후의 대결이 가까워지고 있어. 너희 쪽도 움직이고... 우리 쪽도 그래. 다음에 만나면 우린 적이야.
Overture to Despair#579.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#580.src: ...ha. You would say that, wouldn't you?
Overture to Despair#580.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#581.src: But I can't. Not anymore. The moment I took the blessing, I made the choice. I have to see it through.
Overture to Despair#581.dst: 하지만 난 못 해. 이제는. 축복을 받은 순간, 난 선택을 했어. 끝까지 가야 해.
Overture to Despair#581.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#582.src: It was given for a purpose, and... I can't back out now. I can't.
Overture to Despair#582.dst: 목적이 있어서 받은 거고... 이제 와서 물러설 순 없어. 못 해.
Overture to Despair#582.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#584.src: Sigh... goodbye, {u}. I'm sure I'll see you soon.
Overture to Despair#584.dst: 하아... 잘 가, {u}. 곧 다시 보게 될 거야.
Overture to Despair#584.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#586.src: I am. There's too much at stake to just... turn back now. I've made this choice, and now... I have to see it through.
Overture to Despair#586.dst: 그래. 걸린 게 너무 많아서... 이제 와서 돌아설 순 없어. 난 선택했고, 이제... 끝까지 가야 해.
Overture to Despair#586.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#587.src: I... don't see a way to save the world, if not with her. I don't know if anyone else could stand against what we're facing.
Overture to Despair#587.dst: 난... 그녀가 아니면 세상을 구할 방법이 안 보여. 우리가 맞선 것에 대항할 수 있는 사람이 또 있을지 모르겠어.
Overture to Despair#587.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#589.src: ... Goodbye, {u}. I'm sure I'll see you soon.
Overture to Despair#589.dst: ... 잘 가, {u}. 곧 다시 보게 될 거야.
Overture to Despair#589.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#591.src: What... what is Fruma to you, if you don't mind me asking? If you're... you know. Why are you here, instead of there?
Overture to Despair#591.dst: 뭐... Fruma가 너한테 뭐야, 물어봐도 된다면? 네가... 알잖아. 왜 거기 말고 여기 있는 거야?
Overture to Despair#591.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#593.src: There is little more I would like than to forget that... place, that cage entirely.
Overture to Despair#593.dst: 그곳을... 그 우리를 완전히 잊는 것보다 더 바라는 것은 없노라.
Overture to Despair#593.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#594.src: ...from the moment of conception. It was given nothing. It was Their hatred, Their disdain, Their battlefield, suddenly given the mind to think and form to feel.
Overture to Despair#594.dst: ...잉태된 순간부터. 그것에겐 아무것도 주어지지 않았다. 그것은 그들의 증오, 그들의 경멸, 그들의 전장이었으나, 느닷없이 생각할 정신과 느낄 형체를 얻었노라.
Overture to Despair#594.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#595.src: ...and oh, how It grew to hate that cage, to hate those who had put It there to rot.
Overture to Despair#595.dst: ...그리고 오, 그것은 그 우리를 얼마나 증오하게 되었던가. 그곳에 가둬 썩게 한 자들을 얼마나 증오했던가.
Overture to Despair#595.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#596.src: Its only solace was found in glimpses of a world beyond. Mere specks reflected off the scattered shards of War.
Overture to Despair#596.dst: 유일한 위안은 바깥 세계를 엿보는 것이었다. 흩어진 전쟁의 파편에 비친 작은 티끌들뿐이었지.
Overture to Despair#596.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#597.src: I took that cage and shattered Its bars. I freed myself from what It was made to be.
Overture to Despair#597.dst: 나는 그 우리의 창살을 부쉈노라. 그것이 되도록 만들어진 모습에서 나 자신을 해방했노라.
Overture to Despair#597.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#598.src: This province... I have made it a home. It is everything I could have ever dreamed could be mine. It is... everything, to me.
Overture to Despair#598.dst: 이 지방... 나는 이곳을 집으로 삼았다. 내 것이 되리라 꿈꿀 수 있었던 모든 것이지. 내게는... 전부이니라.
Overture to Despair#598.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#599.src: But now, I have something I could lose. Something to protect at any cost. I would give anything to ensure its safety...
Overture to Despair#599.dst: 허나 이제, 내겐 잃을 수 있는 것이 생겼다. 무슨 대가를 치르더라도 지킬 것이. 그 안전을 위해선 무엇이든 내주리라...
Overture to Despair#599.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#600.src: ... Tasim looks down at the ground.
Overture to Despair#600.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#601.src: I think I know the feeling.
Overture to Despair#601.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Overture to Despair#000~1.src: - No weaponry or blessed equipment in common areas.
Overture to Despair#000~1.dst: - 공용 구역에서는 무기나 축복받은 장비 금지.

Overture to Despair#002~1.src: No matter, it can be sorted ou-

Overture to Despair#005~1.src: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change.
Overture to Despair#005~1.dst: 오래 묻힌 진실을 파헤치고 변화를 이끌어 내기를.

similar.text: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change. Never forget that.

Overture to Despair#006~1.src: Different plants require different soils, temperatures and water requirements.
Overture to Despair#006~1.dst: 식물마다 필요한 흙, 온도, 물이 다르다.

Overture to Despair#007~1.src: At first, I was afraid of being labeled as cursed. But power does not come without risk. I am willing to risk everything for power.
Overture to Despair#007~1.dst: 처음엔 저주받았다는 낙인이 찍힐까 두려웠어. 하지만 위험 없는 힘은 없지. 힘을 위해서라면 모든 걸 걸 수 있어.

Overture to Despair#009~1.dst: 미니 퀘스트 시작: 흰 백합 채집

Overture to Despair#010~1.src: I only serve customers with something to show me.
Overture to Despair#010~1.dst: 보여 줄 게 있는 손님만 받습니다.

Overture to Despair#012~1.src: Do you want to play a song?

Overture to Despair#013~1.src: - Late checkout will come with a {~}  fine.

Overture to Despair#014~1.src: You open a page at random...

Overture to Despair#015~1.src: Unsurprisingly, it's talking about Majin's love life. You look inside.
Overture to Despair#015~1.dst: 역시나 Majin의 연애사 이야기다. 안을 들여다본다.

Overture to Despair#017~1.src: The painting most likely symbolises the destruction of the Auburn of old and the hope of a better time to come.
Overture to Despair#017~1.dst: 이 그림은 아마 옛 Auburn의 파괴와 더 나은 시대에 대한 희망을 상징하는 것 같다.

Overture to Despair#018~1.src: Painted in {~}NA by Piju Rae. This oil masterpiece embraces revolutionary color techniques using pigments sourced from the highland dye production.
Overture to Despair#018~1.dst: Piju Rae가 {~}NA에 그림. 이 유화 걸작은 고원 염료 산지에서 얻은 안료로 혁신적인 색채 기법을 담아냈다.

Overture to Despair#019~1.src: Yes, hello, you staring at me from across the desk, give me a moment I've ran out of ink.
Overture to Despair#019~1.dst: 네, 안녕하세요, 책상 건너편에서 저를 쳐다보는 분, 잠깐만요. 잉크가 떨어졌어요.

Overture to Despair#020~1.src: To a lesser extent we also monitor trade between the other districts in Fruma, including anything transported via rail.
Overture to Despair#020~1.dst: 그보다 비중은 덜하지만 Fruma의 다른 구역 간 무역도 감시합니다. 철도로 운송되는 것도 포함해서요.

Overture to Despair#023~1.src: Heather is a simple starting plant to grow in the {p}. Any acidic soil from the {p} can be used in the gardening bed or flower pot.
Overture to Despair#023~1.dst: 헤더는 {p}에서 기르기 쉬운 입문용 식물입니다. {p}의 산성 토양이라면 무엇이든 화단이나 화분에 쓸 수 있습니다.

Overture to Despair#024~1.src: Excuse me. It has been a long day. Again, any questions?
Overture to Despair#024~1.dst: 실례했습니다. 긴 하루였거든요. 다시 묻죠, 질문 있으십니까?

Overture to Despair#025~1.src: To keep it working as intended, the power to issue death sentences should be limited. Giving one trusted official, besides Her Majesty, the right to pass
Overture to Despair#025~1.dst: 의도대로 작동하게 하려면 사형 선고 권한은 제한되어야 한다. 여왕 폐하 외에 신뢰할 수 있는 관리 한 명에게만 선고할 권리를 주

Overture to Despair#027~1.src: Would you like to keep reading?

Overture to Despair#028~1.src: Right. that is the thirty first time I have had to write that sentence today, the third pot of ink I've been through, and my hands are starting to shake.
Overture to Despair#028~1.dst: 좋아요. 오늘 이 문장을 쓴 게 서른한 번째고, 잉크는 세 병째 쓰고 있고, 손이 떨리기 시작하네요.

Overture to Despair#029~1.src: Do you want to get some ice?

Overture to Despair#030~1.src: Paper published and written by Majin in {~}IA.

Overture to Despair#033~1.src: You are gripped by terror. You can't bear to read more.
Overture to Despair#033~1.dst: 공포에 사로잡힌다. 더는 읽을 수가 없다.

Overture to Despair#034~1.src: "SO YEAH, OF COURSE WE'RE GOING TO REPEAT A FEW QUESTIONS. ALRIGHT? GET OVER YOURSELVES."
Overture to Despair#034~1.dst: "그래, 당연히 몇몇 질문은 반복할 거야. 알았어? 잘난 척 좀 그만해."

Overture to Despair#035~1.src: There's a picture of a funny looking fish. The headline reads as follows:
Overture to Despair#035~1.dst: 우스꽝스럽게 생긴 물고기 그림이 있다. 헤드라인은 다음과 같다:

Overture to Despair#036~1.src: New Chapter Started: Blossom of Blades

Overture to Despair#037~1.src: "Fish Experts Warn Dangerous New Invasive Fish Headed For {p}. Its Diet? Your-"
Overture to Despair#037~1.dst: "어류 전문가 경고: 위험한 신종 침입 어종이 {p}(으)로 향하는 중. 먹이는? 당신의-"

Overture to Despair#106~1.src: Here, the cheapest I have available. In total, that will cost you... {~} .
Overture to Despair#106~1.dst: 여기, 제가 가진 것 중 가장 싼 겁니다. 전부 합쳐서... {~} .
Overture to Despair#106~1.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#107~1.src: Where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel.
Overture to Despair#107~1.dst: 땅속에 묻힌 강철 선로로 지역들이 만나는 곳.

Overture to Despair#125~1.src: I see. I see. That certainly complicates things...
Overture to Despair#125~1.dst: 그렇군요. 그렇군요. 그러면 확실히 일이 복잡해지는데...
Overture to Despair#125~1.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#126~1.src: "Day after day, the voices greet the seekers. Identify the truth, and read the secrets printed."
Overture to Despair#126~1.dst: "날마다 목소리들이 탐구자를 맞이한다. 진실을 가려내고, 인쇄된 비밀을 읽어라."

Overture to Despair#227~1.src: I'm... feeling a lot better now. Um... what should we do now, then? While we... wait for midnight.
Overture to Despair#227~1.dst: 이제... 훨씬 나아졌어. 음... 그럼 이제 뭘 할까? 우리가... 자정을 기다리는 동안.
Overture to Despair#227~1.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#228~1.src: I long for a worthy opponent, someone I can fully explore the depths of the endless cosmos with. Maybe then my hunger will be satiated.
Overture to Despair#228~1.dst: 나는 걸맞은 적수를 갈망한다. 끝없는 우주의 심연을 함께 온전히 탐구할 수 있는 자를. 그때가 되면 내 허기도 채워지겠지.

Overture to Despair#242~1.src: I'm... ugh. I'm still so angry. At... everything! The crown, the sovereigns, the... the people of {p}, too!! For... for still living their lives, even... even when it feels like the world's ended.
Overture to Despair#242~1.dst: 난... 으. 아직도 너무 화가 나. 모든 것에! 왕실에도, 군주들에게도, 그... {p} 사람들에게도!! 아직도... 아직도 자기 삶을 살고 있으니까. 세상이 끝난 것만 같은데도.
Overture to Despair#242~1.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#392~1.src: I mean, really, what use could I actually have had for those two? Waste my efforts pulling information out of them that I already know?
Overture to Despair#392~1.dst: 그러니까, 정말로, 그 둘을 내가 어디에 쓸 수 있었겠어? 이미 아는 정보를 캐내느라 힘을 낭비하라고?
Overture to Despair#392~1.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Overture to Despair#393~1.src: You tell her how you finally killed it. How it fought, and fought, and fought, but could not take you down. How the Light was freed from the Shadows.
Overture to Despair#393~1.dst: 마침내 그것을 어떻게 죽였는지 그녀에게 말한다. 그것이 싸우고, 싸우고, 또 싸웠지만 끝내 당신을 쓰러뜨리지 못했음을. 빛이 어떻게 그림자에서 풀려났는지를.

Overture to Despair#642.src: ...from the moment of conception, It was given nothing. It was Their hatred, Their disdain, Their battlefield, suddenly given the mind to think and form to feel.
Overture to Despair#642.dst: ...잉태된 순간부터, 그것은 아무것도 받지 못했다. 그것은 그들의 증오, 그들의 경멸, 그들의 전장이었고, 갑자기 생각할 정신과 느낄 형체를 얻었다.
Overture to Despair#642.speaker: Her Majesty

Overture to Despair#643.src: ...but we have some hope. F-finally. Rex and Zeph... there's still a chance. There's still a chance we'll get to see them again.
Overture to Despair#643.dst: ...하지만 희망이 좀 생겼어. 드-드디어. Rex와 Zeph... 아직 기회가 있어. 그들을 다시 볼 기회가 아직 있어.

Overture to Despair#644.src: "Rooted deep atop the house of wealth and greed, the branches hear the whispers on the breeze."
Overture to Despair#644.dst: "부와 탐욕의 집 꼭대기에 깊이 뿌리내린 가지들은 바람결의 속삭임을 듣는다."

Overture to Despair#645.src: You tell her about entering the portal with Lari. About seeing the realm's connections severed, made smaller.
Overture to Despair#645.dst: Lari와 함께 포털에 들어간 일을 그녀에게 말한다. 그 영역의 연결이 끊기고 좁아진 모습을 본 일을.

Overture to Despair#646.src: "The whispers speak of unity, called forth where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel."
Overture to Despair#646.dst: "속삭임은 단결을 말하니, 땅속에 묻힌 강철 선로로 지역들이 만나는 곳에서 불러일으켜진다."

Overture to Despair#647.src: You tell her about fighting through the nexus. About the battle between Light and Dark ongoing within.
Overture to Despair#647.dst: 넥서스를 뚫고 싸워 나간 일을 그녀에게 말한다. 그 안에서 계속되는 빛과 어둠의 전투를.

Overture to Despair#648.src: Casting simple spells drawing power from the cosmos feels like holding fragile explosives in my hand. One wrong move and I'm afraid it will swallow me, or the world, whole.
Overture to Despair#648.dst: 우주에서 힘을 끌어와 간단한 주문을 쓰는 것조차 깨지기 쉬운 폭발물을 손에 쥔 느낌이야. 한 번만 잘못 움직여도 그게 나를, 아니면 세상을 통째로 삼켜 버릴까 봐 두려워.
